title: Data Engineer - Databricks
description:
INGRITY is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join a major financial services organisation undergoing a data modernisation program. The role sits in a modern Databricks environment, building scalable pipelines and migrating legacy platforms to a cloud-based lakehouse.

You will design, develop and optimize pipelines, transform complex datasets and collaborate with engineers, analysts, and stakeholders in a hybrid Sydney/Brisbane setting.

Design, develop and optimise data pipelines using Databricks, Python/PySpark and SQL. Build and maintain data transformations using dbt and Delta Lake. Develop scalable data models across Bronze, Silver and Gold layers. Support data migration from legacy platforms, including SAS. Implement data quality checks, testing and performance optimisation. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts and business stakeholders. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, PySpark and SQL. Experience with dbt, Delta Lake and lake house architecture. Proven experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines. Experience with cloud platforms, ideally Azure or AWS. Understanding of CI/CD, data testing and production support. Experience in insurance or financial services highly regarded. Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Databricks Genie advantageous.

title: Fully Remote Fullstack Developer: React + Python
description:

Build and ship features across the full stack, using React/TypeScript on the frontend and Python/FastAPI on the backend. Design and consume REST and GraphQL APIs, including real-time features where needed. Model and query data in PostgreSQL and related databases. Implement UI from Figma designs with backend engineers. Maintain strong testing culture with pytest and Jest, and participate in code reviews. Work with Dockerized and cloud-native AWS deployments. 6+ years of commercial fullstack experience. Solid Python (async; FastAPI, Flask or Django). Strong command of relational databases/SQL (PostgreSQL preferred). Experience with REST APIs and GraphQL. Day-to-day Docker and Git workflows. Habit of writing automated tests. Hands-on AWS experience. English at B2 level.

title: Kinship Specialist
description:
Under the general supervision of the FCS Director of Specialized Family Focused Services, the Kinship Specialist supports kinship caregivers to promote placement stability, reunification, and child safety. Referrals originate with the Iowa Department of Health and Human Services (HHS); referrals for CFI’s subcontracted kinship services are received directly from the contract holder. The position requires travel throughout the assigned service area.


Provide culturally responsive support to kinship caregivers of all races, religions, ages, genders, gender expressions, sexual orientations, socioeconomic backgrounds, and physical or mental health circumstances. Services aim to increase kinship placements, reduce placements with unrelated foster caregivers, promote placement stability, and reduce repeat maltreatment.


Key Responsibilities

Caregiver Engagement and Direct Services

  • Engage families and orient them to FCS Kinship Navigation Services within required contract timelines.
  • Independently assess caregiver strengths and needs using evidence-based tools.
  • Identify formal and informal family supports using ecomaps and other assessment tools.
  • Develop a Kinship Care Plan with caregivers that includes action steps tied to identified outcomes. Help caregivers locate affordable child care, access medical, dental, and mental health services, and meet basic needs such as clothing, beds, cribs, furniture, food, and transportation.
  • Connect caregivers with resources such as food and child care assistance, the Family Investment Program (FIP), health insurance, and legal aid. Assist with applications as needed.
  • Connect caregivers with counseling, parent education, support groups, and other supportive services.
  • Provide information about the kinship caregiver payment program and foster care licensing options.
  • Facilitate collaboration between biological parents and kinship caregivers when requested by the contract holder and/or HHS. Help caregivers understand expectations for supervising family interactions and provide training to prepare for and manage potential challenges. Communicate any limitations or concerns to the FCS Director of Specialized Family Focused Services and the Contract Supervisor.
  • Assist kinship caregivers interested in becoming licensed foster or adoptive parents with applications and required paperwork.
  • Meet all direct-service requirements established in the FCS Kinship Navigation Services contract, including meeting frequency and duration.
  • Work a schedule that responds to family and program needs, including evenings and some weekends. Provide services in the family’s home whenever possible.

Collaboration and Caregiver Support

  • Attend Child Safety Conferences, Family Focused Meetings, case reviews, unit meetings, and court hearings as requested by kinship caregivers to provide support and resource information. Attend in person unless virtual participation is permitted.
  • Maintain regular communication, as appropriate, with the FCS Director of Specialized Family Focused Services, the Contract Supervisor, and/or the HHS worker regarding caregiver participation, resource needs, and family supports. Collaborate with other service professionals and community providers.
  • Assist with developing and facilitating kinship caregiver supports, which may include in-person or virtual support groups, newsletters, and social media groups.

Documentation and Contract Compliance

  • Complete and maintain case-specific intake paperwork, assessments, notes, and reports in designated electronic systems according to contract requirements and CFI policies.
  • Complete all reporting and data collection required by the contract holder accurately and within established deadlines.
  • Complete month-end billing and expense reports within deadlines established by the contract and agency policy.
  • Protect client confidentiality in verbal, written, and electronic communications and maintain secure client records in accordance with applicable confidentiality requirements and policies.

  • Demo reel that reflects everyday work.

title: Manager Supplier Quality, Interior/Exterior
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • Lead supplier quality planning and execution of manufacturing, assembly techniques and quality control processes from the advanced development phase to serial production.
  • Oversee the integration of interior components such as dashboards, door panels, headliners, center consoles, and seating trims to deliver a comfortable, safe, and visually appealing cabin.
  • Lead creation and refinement of the external features of vehicles — including body panels, roof systems, aerodynamics, lighting, and trim that deliver innovative, high-quality exterior solutions that meet customer needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage evaluation of materials (plastics, fabrics, leather, composites) for durability, comfort, and safety compliance; Conduct material and prototype testing to meet automotive industry regulations and customer requirements.
  • Work with cross-functional teams: Design, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering and Logistics.
  • Lead and oversee all quality performance and functional standards quality in all vehicle activities are met in the supply chain to ensure Customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure professional business acumen of SQEs at suppliers to ensure Scout’s Quality expectations and core values are met and that suppliers can meet the industrialization related activities on time with the Supplier Quality team.
  • Responsible that suppliers will meet industrialization, to schedule, and at cost to ensure quality.
  • Responsible for Supplier PPAPs and ongoing activities within the Supply Chain.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide technical guidance throughout the development cycle.
  • Work as a partner with the Supply Chain to ensure escalations of issues are raised, and resolutions are solved in a timely manner.
  • Lead supplier improvements in cost, quality and manufacturability Responsible for ensuring supplier audits and corrective actions are completed on time.
  • Collaborate with Scout’s Design, Quality, and Manufacturing to determine the ideal performance specifications and supplier metrics.
  • Accountable for ongoing monitoring supplier manufacturing process development, launch readiness for new products and design changes.
  • Drive continuous improvement activities utilizing Lean Manufacturing principles.
  • Ensure suppliers have exceptionally robust processes and procedures to promote mass industrialization through efficient and seamless production of high-quality products.
  • Build a team of Supplier Quality professionals to ensure the utmost caliber of supplier audits are conducted and build partnerships within the supply chain.
  • Mentor team members, foster a culture of learning, and facilitate skill development to enhance the capabilities of the Supplier Quality team.
  • Work cross functionally with other departments within Scout
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Location & Travel Expectations:

  • This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Blythewood, South Carolina
  • This role requires 5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.
  • Travel: Domestic and international travel required, approximately 50-80% of the time. Valid driver's license required. Passport required

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

  • Bachelor’s in Mechanical/Vehicle/Electrical/Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, Business or related field; Master’s a plus
  • 7 – 10 years of experience in automotive engineering/product quality, with at least 3 years in a leadership role with disciplinary or technical leadership responsibility in an OEM/ Tier 1
  • Experience in Quality Systems a plus: QTR/QPNi/PPA/VDA 6.3/VDA 6.5/SAMSON/ AVON/ TEVON/LiOn/BeOn
  • Demonstrated proven technical leadership ability with regards to Automotive Engineering/Product Quality; Interior & Exterior commodity experience preferred
  • Lead cross-functional Supplier Quality task force involving Engineering, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Supplier Readiness, Production Quality, and Suppliers
  • Sound knowledge of vehicle development, vehicle production and Supply Chain Management
  • Financial Acumen Required
  • In-depth knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and inspection
  • Understanding of safety requirements
  • Understanding of IATF, VDA, ISO, DIN, and regulatory requirements: Lead or support supplier process audits, VDA 6.3 Potential Analysis, and Supplier Risk Assessments
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, a high level of assertiveness as well as entrepreneurial thinking and goal- and result-oriented decision-making skills
  • Leadership and team management abilities, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams
  • Proven ability to execute Program Management from a leadership level
  • Strong technical writing ability using SPC and data analysis as well as an ability to explain complex issues in a concise and plain manner
  • Ability to travel 50-80% of the time (International Travel Required -Passport Necessary)

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

  • Competitive insurance including:
    • Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
  • 401(k) program with:
    • An employer match and immediate vesting
  • Generous Paid Time Off including:
    • 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
    • 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
    • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
    • Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave
  • Corporate Vehicle Program with:
    • Eligibility for 1 assigned vehicle
    • A mobility stipend

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial Base Salary Range: $120,000.00 - $145,000.00

Internal Leveling Code: M8

Notice to applicants:

  • To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  • Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.
  • Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws.   • FIFO from Perth | 8/6 days, 7/7 nights rotating roster at Granny Smith
  • Build your career with a leading owner-operator gold producer
  • Underground and/or surface paste crew experience required

The Opportunity

As a Pastefill Operator, you’ll support underground infrastructure by installing, operating and maintaining pastefill reticulation systems to ensure ground stability and enable ongoing mining activities.

Reporting to the Supervisor Pastefill, you’ll join a high-performing, tight-knit crew that plays a vital role in underground production and development. If you’d like to make your mark underground, we’d love to hear from you!

  • Permanent role with a leading gold producer
  • 6% site allowance and quarterly bonus up to 10% annually

  • 6 weeks annual leave, pro-rata long service leave after 5 years

  • Installing, operating, and maintaining underground paste reticulation systems and pipelines, bulkheads/barricades, compressed air, ventilation, and water/dewatering systems

  • Proven pastefill experience in surface and underground crews, whether operating paste plant and/or reticulation systems and installing and maintaining paste pipelines and related infrastructure

  • Valid manual C Class Driver’s Licence
  • WA Dangerous Goods Security Card and Working at Heights

title: Business Unit Lead
description:
Barden is delighted to partner with a large, established Irish organisation as they look to hire a Business Unit Lead. This is a commercially focused leadership role, with ownership of strategy, suppliers, pricing, and range for a key product area.


You will shape how the business unit grows, working closely with sales, finance, operations, and marketing teams, and building supplier relationships that matter.


“We need someone with sharp commercial judgement who is confident negotiating with suppliers and bringing colleagues with them. The person who joins will have real influence over where this business unit goes next.”


ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Set the strategy for the business unit, using market insight to find growth and innovation opportunities.
  • Own pricing, range, and assortment decisions, informed by market and competitor trends.
  • Lead supplier negotiations and build strategic partnerships, including exclusive ranges.
  • Plan and run promotions with marketing and suppliers, and measure what works.
  • Track sales, margin, and cost against targets, and forecast with finance.
  • Work with sales and operations teams on inventory levels and customer-focused initiatives.


ABOUT THE PERSON

  • 5-10 years Business Unit leadership or category management experience, ideally in wholesale, distibution, Retail, FMCG.
  • Degree qualified in Business, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of the Irish market and competitive landscape.
  • Excellent negotiator who builds strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills, and proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
  • Results-focused, with a record of delivering profitable growth.

title: Multiple Full Stack.Net & Senior Full Stack.Net Software Developers
description:
Compas Pty Ltd is seeking multiple full stack .NET and senior full stack .NET software developers for a Government software program in Canberra, ACT. The roles involve securing full stack applications with .NET, SQL and JavaScript frameworks, and contributing to data integration and analytical capabilities.

Required is a current NV1 clearance minimum, with eligibility for NV2, and a start ASAP through 30 June with options to extend for two 12‑month periods. On-site work in Canberra is expected.

Develop, test, deploy and maintain secure full stack applications using .NET, SQL and JavaScript frameworks. Modernise front-end applications using Angular and/or Svelte, including refactoring and performance improvements. Build and integrate backend services, APIs and data pipelines for enterprise data integration and analytics. Contribute to Agile Scrum delivery, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code reviews and application support. Minimum 5 years' experience across SQL development. Experience with .NET backend development. Experience with JavaScript front-end frameworks (Angular, React, Vue, or Svelte). Strong DevOps experience covering CI/CD pipelines and automated testing. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

title: Staff Network Automation & DevOps Engineer
description:
PlayStation in Ireland seeks a Staff Network Systems Engineer to drive automation and modernise our global network. You will implement Infrastructure as Code, build reusable automation, and lead safe migrations while working across engineering, security and architecture teams.

You will shape standards, establish a trusted source of truth, and mentor engineers as you deliver end-to-end, auditable changes in a complex production environment.

Lead transition to a standardised, version-controlled and automated network operating model. Establish Infrastructure as Code practices, reusable automation and automated validation. Reduce configuration drift and make changes repeatable, auditable and safer. Collaborate across network, security, architecture and platform teams to shape direction and standards. Define a phased modernisation roadmap for network estate, toolchain and workflows. Build automation with Python, Go, Terraform and Ansible; use APIs and config-management tooling. Develop CI/CD pipelines with linting, testing, drift detection and controlled rollouts. Translate network intent into version-controlled implementations and influence reference architectures. Migrate existing services into the automated model while staying hands-on during delivery. Mentor engineers and contribute to governance forums to institutionalise automation. Deep enterprise networking knowledge including routing, switching, wireless and secure remote connectivity. Advanced Juniper Mist, EX Series and Junos experience or equivalent platform expertise. Hands-on software engineering skills in Python and Go, with maintainable code and APIs. Staff-level influence and communication skills across teams, governance forums and mentoring.

title: Lead Data Modeller - Enterprise Analytics & Governance
description:
DFP Recruitment is looking for a Lead Data Modeller to drive enterprise data modelling initiatives across multiple projects and programs. You will lead the design, governance and optimisation of data models that support modern data platforms, reporting and analytics capabilities.

Working with architects, engineers and business stakeholders, you will establish best-practice data standards, ensure data quality and enable scalable, data-driven decision making globally within the organisation.

Lead design and governance of enterprise semantic models, certified datasets, KPIs, and business metrics. Collaborate with stakeholders and data architects to translate requirements into models. Design and develop fact/dimension models using star schema principles. Develop analytical models in data warehouse with SQL transformations. Create reusable semantic models in BI tools to support enterprise reporting. Define KPIs, calculations and reusable business logic. Coordinate with data engineering to source data and ensure analytics readiness. Optimize performance of semantic models and query plans. Ensure governance and avoid duplicating logic across reports. Extensive experience leading enterprise data modelling in large, complex environments. Translate business requirements into logical, physical and semantic models. Hands-on Snowflake modelling with complex SQL transformations. Proficiency with ERWin and other modelling tools. Experience building scalable semantic models for BI platforms.

Strong background as a full-stack developer. Experience with cross-platform design and shared components. Interest in projects involving complex business logic. title: Senior Product Engineer: AI-powered Legal Tech & Integrations
description:

You’ll drive cloud, CI/CD and IaC practices, and own end-to-end delivery from concept to production, with a hybrid work model and opportunities for coaching and career development.

Build and own applications, APIs and integrations from idea to production. Work across the intake tech ecosystem (Amazon Connect, HubSpot, Morry) to improve experiences. Run AI agents across planning, coding, testing and review. Sit with users and stakeholders to identify real problems and fix them. Prototype quickly, test early and move successes to production. Maintain quality with automated testing, AI evaluation, security, and CI/CD. Shape architecture and uplift the broader engineering team. Deep hands-on engineering and architecture experience on production apps and integrations. Strong cloud architecture, system integration, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code skills. Experience with AI agents or agent-enabled workflows, including safe production checks. Sound engineering judgement and a product mindset. You can collaborate with engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Curiosity and willingness to learn and try new tools. Hybrid work model Career development Mental health support Parental leave Life insurance Leave loading Wellbeing days

title: Senior .NET Engineer — Enterprise Web Apps & Azure DevOps
description:

Designs and develops the system. Optimizes software for performance, security and quality. Produces technical documentation. Estimates effort and time for development. Contributes to requirements analysis, testing and deployment. Tests solutions and develops testing tools. Prototypes solutions. Acts as 2nd and 3rd line support. Bachelor's degree and 6+ years IT experience. English language at least B2 level. Minimum 3 years of project experience relevant to the profile.

description:

Leads ServiceNow development activities for the ServiceNow project, architecting complex technical solutions across ITSM, ITOM, ITBM, IRM, SecOps, and custom applications.   • Develops advanced server side scripting including Business Rules, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, and Fix Scripts
  • Implements sophisticated client side development using Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Angular components

  • Mentors mid-level and junior developers on ServiceNow architecture, development patterns, and best practices

  • Implements ServiceNow security controls including ACLs, roles, and data access policies • Collaborates with architects, business analysts, and stakeholders translating requirements into technical solutions

  • 7 years of ServiceNow development experience with proven expertise in complex platform customization and integration
  • Certifications: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

  • Federal government experience
  • Certifications: ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in multiple modules, Certified Technical Architect (CTA)

  • TS/SCI with polygraph level clearance required

Strong builder with focus on outcomes, speed, quality and measurable business impact. Familiarity with Python is beneficial.

Own meaningful pieces of the migration of product surfaces into independently deployable microfrontends, which could include moving a subset of functionality into its own remote, versioning its contract with the host, and handling version skew and shared dependencies Design, build and operate data-intensive customer-facing surfaces in Redpanda Cloud end to end, from design review through release to production operation Build the graceful degradation and fallback behaviour that keeps our Cloud interfaces responsive and usable when a remote has issues Maintain release confidence by adding testing at all levels from unit tests to end-to-end, and keeping them fast and trustworthy Contribute to the design system and component library, keeping components composable across independently deployed products, and consumable by AI coding agents Write RFCs for your own work, review others' designs and code, and contribute to frontend standards Work with the backend engineers, who own the high volume low latency data platform, so that the UX works with backend APIs, and information-architecture decisions land well in the UI Take part in the on-call rotation for cloud services, and improve its operational health Help teammates grow through pairing and code review 5+ years of experience building and operating production customer-facing web applications with React and TypeScript, including owning features or whole surfaces end to end

description:

This role blends database engineering, site reliability, cloud architecture, and platform automation. You will design, deploy, and optimize data infrastructure, promote best practices, and mentor teams to raise the bar for data reliability.

Own design, operation, and scaling of cloud datastores (Postgres, Redis) on AWS. Lead datastore optimization: queries, indexing, schema design, caching, maintenance. Plan and execute scaling using replicas, partitioning, sharding, archival. Define SLOs, RPO/RTO targets, and incident runbooks for data reliability. Improve deployment pipelines and zero-downtime migrations while reducing risk. Mentor teammates and raise data reliability standards across the company. Experience building and operating large-scale datastores (Postgres, Redis) in cloud environments. Hands-on with query planning, indexing, replication, upgrades, and performance diagnostics under production load. Strong Python skills; Django experience a plus. Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and release automation. Familiarity with security/compliance for sensitive data and data governance. Comprehensive healthcare 401(K) and pension plans Paid parental leave Flexible work schedule Health and wellness stipend Meaningful equity All holidays recognized Volunteer time off Team-building events

title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager / Data Governance Manager

description:
Role Description

The Cloud Infrastructure Manager / Data Governance Manager is responsible for overseeing enterprise cloud infrastructure, strengthening data management frameworks, and ensuring the reliability, security, and effective governance of organizational technology resources. This role combines cloud infrastructure management with data governance oversight to support business continuity, operational efficiency, information security, and strategic data utilization.

The position involves developing and implementing cloud infrastructure strategies, managing cloud environments, and ensuring that technology platforms remain scalable, reliable, and aligned with organizational requirements. Key responsibilities include overseeing cloud architecture, infrastructure deployment, system availability, network connectivity, storage resources, backup procedures, and disaster recovery planning.

The manager will coordinate infrastructure operations, monitor system performance, identify technical risks, and implement improvements to enhance service reliability and resource utilization. This includes managing cloud service providers, evaluating technology solutions, coordinating infrastructure upgrades, and ensuring that cloud resources are appropriately configured and maintained.

In addition, the role oversees the development and implementation of data governance policies, standards, and procedures. Responsibilities include establishing data ownership structures, defining data quality requirements, maintaining data classification frameworks, and promoting consistent data management practices across business departments.

The position will support data stewardship activities, metadata management, data lifecycle controls, and the implementation of policies covering data access, accuracy, integrity, retention, and protection. It will also coordinate with information security, compliance, technology, and business teams to ensure that data assets are managed responsibly and in accordance with applicable regulatory and internal requirements.

Further responsibilities include identifying infrastructure and data governance risks, maintaining technical documentation, preparing performance reports, and supporting internal audits and compliance assessments. The manager will also lead cross-functional initiatives to improve cloud efficiency, strengthen data controls, and establish consistent technology and information management standards.

The successful candidate will contribute to a secure, scalable, and well-governed technology environment while ensuring that cloud infrastructure and enterprise data resources effectively support organizational objectives.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cloud Computing, Data Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure architecture, enterprise technology environments, and data governance principles.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, infrastructure services, networking, storage, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality management, metadata management, and data lifecycle controls.
  • Familiarity with data classification, access management, information security, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Ability to evaluate infrastructure performance, identify operational risks, and recommend technical improvements.
  • Knowledge of cloud resource optimization, system monitoring, and infrastructure management practices.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to develop policies, procedures, technical documentation, and management reports.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Edenred

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

The UAE CONTEXT

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

THE ROLE

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

  • Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

  • Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

  • De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

  • Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

  • Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

  • Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

  • Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

  • Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

  • Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

  • Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

  • Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

  • Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

  • Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

  • Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

  • Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

  • Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

  • Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

  • Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

  • Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

REPORTING STRUCTURE

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, Financial Crime, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and product managers across the business.

WHY THIS ROLE

You will not be the eleventh PM on a mature product in a crowded market. You will own high-visibility initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition to measurable business outcome, on a platform that has a direct, visible effect on the financial lives of millions of people.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, apply.

Edenred UAE is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or background.

title: Project Manager, Clinical Digital Health Devices
description:
Job Title: Device Capability Lead – Digital Health

Location: Remote, need to be located in Ireland

Duration: 12-months with potential to extend

Start Date: January 4th, 2027 or ASAP


Job Description:

The Device Capabilities Lead will support the continued development and expansion of the client’s Clinical Digital Health Device capabilities within Clinical Laboratory Sciences (CLS). This individual will provide technical and operational oversight of cardiovascular device technologies, with a primary focus on electrocardiogram (ECG/EKG) devices, cardiac monitoring and digital health technologies used in clinical research.

As the organization's cardiovascular device capabilities continue to expand, this role will help address growing operational demands by providing dedicated support for vendor oversight, device-related execution, technical coordination and day-to-day operational responsibilities.


Working closely with internal CLS stakeholders and external vendors, the individual will help establish scalable processes, improve execution and take ownership of responsibilities currently managed by internal team members. This role will also contribute to the development of a more dedicated cardiovascular device capability within CLS, with opportunities to expand responsibilities and support broader digital health initiatives over time.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical understanding of digital health devices and cardiovascular technologies, combined with the ability to lead initiatives, coordinate multiple vendors, manage escalations and drive operational execution. This is a hands-on role suited for someone who understands the technology and can help build and lead a growing capability.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical and operational oversight of cardiovascular digital health devices and technologies supporting clinical research.
  • Support the management and execution of ECG/EKG device capabilities, including multiple device types, vendors and associated technologies.
  • Coordinate and oversee multiple external vendors supporting the same device modality, ensuring deliverables, expectations and operational requirements are met.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for day-to-day vendor execution, issue resolution, escalation management and operational accountability.
  • Manage device-related activities, including equipment coordination, device readiness, connectivity, technical requirements and supporting technology.
  • Develop an understanding of device-generated data, reporting and expected outputs to help identify issues and ensure appropriate execution.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional activities across CLS, Clinical Labs, external vendors and global stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of operational responsibilities currently managed by internal team members to improve team capacity and execution.
  • Help establish, refine and implement processes, workflows and best practices for managing cardiovascular device capabilities.
  • Contribute to future-state planning and the development of a more dedicated cardiovascular device function within CLS.
  • Provide leadership and direction to supporting team members while helping establish accountability across day-to-day activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve vendor execution, operational efficiency and the overall delivery of digital health technology initiatives.
  • Ensure activities align with applicable clinical research standards, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and internal quality requirements.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders, including teams based in the United States and Ireland, to ensure alignment and consistent execution.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare technology, Life Sciences, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of relevant professional experience with a bachelor's degree; ideally 5–7 years. Candidates with a master's degree may qualify with less professional experience.
  • Strong technical understanding of digital health technologies, medical devices, wearables or connected healthcare technologies.
  • Experience supporting technical initiatives, device operations, vendor management or project execution.
  • Ability to understand device functionality, technical requirements, operational workflows and data outputs.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of deliverables, coordinate multiple stakeholders and drive day-to-day execution.
  • Strong communication, organizational, problem-solving and leadership skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a global, cross-functional environment.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience with ECG/EKG devices, cardiovascular monitoring or cardiac technologies, including atrial fibrillation (AFib) monitoring.
  • Familiarity with various cardiovascular device modalities, including non-app-based devices, app-based devices, connected monitoring technologies and equipment that interfaces with laptops or other systems.
  • Experience overseeing multiple external vendors and coordinating technical deliverables.
  • Previous experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research or medical device industry.
  • Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and other regulated clinical research requirements.
  • Experience leading small teams, managing broader initiatives and contributing to future-state capability development.
  • PMP certification or other relevant project management certification.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Some of the key products and features you will work on as an Android engineer include our vehicle connectivity, mapping services, route optimization, EV charging services, vehicle purchasing flows, and more.

  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering shipping customer facing applications on Android.
  • Proficiency in Android application development.
  • Solid understanding of mobile platform architecture, UI/UX design principles and frameworks, GraphQL, mobile security and performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines and mobile release process.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience operating in start-up settings, launching 0 to 1 product, and driving graduation to highly customized applications.

  • Passion for mobile technology and a commitment to delivering exceptional user experiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building systems in the automotive industry.
  • Experience with mobile app testing, experimentation frameworks and automation frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud technologies and services, such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with mobile apps that connect to an IOT device

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

  • Competitive insurance including:
    • Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
  • 401(k) program with:
    • An employer match and immediate vesting
  • Generous Paid Time Off including:
    • 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
    • 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
    • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
    • Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $140,000.00 - $170,000.00

Initial California base salary range= $154,000 - $187,000

Notice to applicants:

  • Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  • Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Who We Are

Fanatics Collectibles, home of Topps, is a global leader in collectibles, bringing fans closer to the sports, athletes, and entertainment properties they love. Topps Digital builds immersive digital collecting games played by collectors worldwide, including Topps BUNT, NFL Collect, Star Wars™: Card Trader, Disney Collect! and many more. Backed by Fanatics’ partnerships across sports and entertainment, we’re defining what it means to be a digital collector.

About the Role

As a Senior UI/UX Designer on the Topps Digital team, reporting to the Senior Manager of UX Design, you’ll reimagine how collectors discover, open, trade, and celebrate their collections. You’ll own design from early concepts through the shipped product, combining clean, intuitive UX with the energy and spectacle of sports and entertainment. You’ll bring a game designer’s instinct for how motion, feedback, and progression pull players deeper into an experience, along with a strong point of view and a passion for craft.

This role is open to both on-site from our Los Angeles office, or remote in the United States.

What You’ll Do

  • Design end-to-end experiences across our mobile games, including core collecting flows, pack openings and reveals, progression and rewards, live events, and the in-app store.

  • Take ideas from sketches and wireframes to polished, production-ready UI and interactive prototypes.

  • Use motion, interaction, and feedback to create high-impact moments that deepen engagement.

  • Evolve our design system (typography, color, iconography, components, and motion) so it scales across properties from sports to film and TV.

  • Partner closely with Engineering to protect interaction quality and visual fidelity through implementation.

  • Work with Product, Brand, Content, Marketing, and Commerce to balance collector needs with business goals, using research and data to inform decisions.

  • Create guidelines and documentation that help internal teams and external partners deliver consistent experiences.

  • Proactively spot opportunities to improve the experience and drive design initiatives forward with minimal oversight.

  • Raise the design bar through thoughtful critique, feedback, and mentorship.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio showing exceptional mobile UI/UX work.

  • Shipped experience designing for video games or gamified apps, including hands-on work on progression, rewards, economy, or live-ops systems.

  • Strong visual design skills and a track record of polished, engaging, intuitive interfaces.

  • Experience using motion, interaction, and storytelling to create memorable experiences.

  • Expertise in Figma, plus experience with motion and rapid prototyping tools (e.g., AI tools, After Effects, Rive, Lottie).

  • Experience contributing to and scaling design systems.

  • A user-centered approach grounded in curiosity about what motivates collectors, and the judgment to balance their needs with business goals.

  • Comfort using user research, analytics, and experimentation to guide and validate design decisions.

  • Ownership of projects from concept to launch, with a strong commitment to quality.

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale and influence cross-functional partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with free-to-play mobile games or in-game store and monetization UX is a big plus.

  • Experience with Unity or with how game UI is implemented.

  • Experience with collection-based or rewards-driven consumer products beyond games.

  • A love of sports, entertainment, or collecting, and ideally experience as a collector yourself.

title: FCS Regional Supervisor
description:
Under the direction of the FCS Regional Director, the FCS Regional Supervisor coordinates daily operations, supports Unit Supervisors, and monitors contract compliance across FCS units. The role connects frontline supervisors, Quality Assurance (QA), and regional leadership to support timely case assignments, accurate documentation, and prompt resolution of service concerns. Duties primarily support the Des Moines Service Area (DSMSA), with travel and coverage in the Western Iowa Service Area (WISA) as needed.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Contract Compliance and Quality Assurance

  • Assist the Regional Director with daily tasks needed to meet FCS contract requirements, agency policies, and applicable licensing and accreditation standards.
  • Serve as the liaison between Unit Supervisors and QA. When deficiencies are identified, promptly coordinate corrective action, identify responsible staff and deadlines, and verify that corrections are completed and communicated to QA.
  • Monitor documentation, reports, case records, and evaluations for completeness and timeliness. Track recurring concerns, address barriers with supervisors, and escalate unresolved deficiencies to the Regional Director.
  • Use QA findings and program data to identify training needs, improve workflows, and evaluate service effectiveness. Support implementation of approved changes and operation within established budget parameters.

Case Assignments and Cross Unit Coordination

  • Coordinate case assignment, reassignment, and coverage across FCS units so referrals are assigned promptly and within contract timelines, staff qualifications, capacity, and service requirements.
  • Confirm that HHS, QA, and affected staff receive required notices of case assignments, transfers, closures, and other case changes within applicable timelines. Verify completion of handoffs and related documentation.
  • Monitor pending referrals, assignment delays, and service gaps; work with Unit Supervisors to resolve barriers and escalate concerns that could affect child safety or contract compliance.
  • Coordinate with internal and external service providers and participate in case reviews or team meetings as needed to support continuity of services.

Unit Supervisor Support and Leadership Communication

  • Bridge communication between Unit Supervisors and regional FCS leadership by clarifying priorities, sharing operational updates, and following through on decisions and action items.
  • Provide day-to-day oversight, coaching, and problem-solving support to Unit Supervisors within delegated authority, including when the Regional Director is supporting other program areas.
  • In coordination with the Regional Director, conduct or participate in regular one-on-one supervision with Unit Supervisors and verify that each unit completes and documents required staff supervision.
  • Assist with interviewing, onboarding, training, performance feedback, employee concerns, and staffing recommendations. Carry out delegated supervisory responsibilities in coordination with the Regional Director and HR.

HHS Partnership and Issue Resolution

  • Maintain productive relationships with HHS and other referral partners. Collect and maintain an objective record of HHS-related operational issues, including dates, service impacts, actions taken, responsible parties, and resolution status.
  • Consolidate trends and unresolved concerns for the Regional Director and communicate approved feedback to HHS promptly through established channels. Track responses and follow-up actions to resolution.

Regional Coverage and Operational Support

Ability to independently analyze systems with interacting mechanical, electrical, and software elements.

title: Research Scientist - Agentic AI and Knowledge Extraction

At Universal Display Corporation (Nasdaq: OLED) (UDC), we’re changing the way people see the world.

If you’re reading this on a smartphone, there’s a good chance UDC’s materials are producing the light and color shining from your screen right now. UDC’s OLED ingredients are key parts of stunning, energy-efficient displays used in everything from smartwatches to phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, TVs and automobiles. Virtually every OLED consumer electronics product around the world uses UDC’s phosphorescent OLED materials and technologies.

UDC is a publicly traded company and pioneer in the OLED industry. When you join our global team, you are embarking on a journey at the forefront of display technology and organic electronics that impacts the daily lives of people around the world. From engineers to chemists, Ph.D. scientists, technicians, lawyers and more, our UDC team is continuously advancing our field. With a focus on energy efficiency, UDC’s team is contributing to making a better, more sustainable planet. Please visit us at .

Job Summary:
Universal Display Corporation is seeking a Research Scientist to develop and deploy agentic AI systems and scientific knowledge-extraction workflows that accelerate molecular discovery and materials research. This role will build multi-agent systems that explore chemical space and propose candidate materials, while developing pipelines that convert patents, scientific literature, and chemical structure images into machine-readable knowledge that these systems can use. The position will contribute to a broader AI/ML and synthetic chemistry team advancing OLED chemistry across the discovery process, from ideation through synthesis and testing. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building LLM-based agents or scientific information-extraction systems, sufficient chemistry knowledge to evaluate their outputs, and the ability to collaborate with ML scientists, computational chemists, and synthetic chemists to move new materials from concept toward experimental validation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and evaluate multi-agent AI systems for molecular discovery, including database-driven exploration and open-ended, chemistry-guided search.

  • Develop workflows that extract molecular structures, properties, and design knowledge from patents, scientific literature, and chemical structure images, including generic and Markush structures.

  • Build retrieval and knowledge-management systems, including vector, graph, and relational databases, that allow agents to search curated scientific corpora.

  • Develop tools, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect agents to predictive models and computational chemistry workflows.

  • Design persistent and shared-memory approaches that enable agentic systems to build on prior discovery efforts.

  • Evaluate agent performance against expert review and incorporate feedback from synthetic chemists into the continuous improvement of agentic workflows.

  • Contribute to secure, reproducible AI infrastructure for deploying agentic systems in isolated cloud and on-premises environments.

Required Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience applying large language models or agentic AI to scientific problems.

  • Proven experience developing agentic AI workflows, LLM tool harnesses, or AI-enabled scientific applications that connect models, tools, data, and user workflows.

  • Experience extracting structured information from scientific text, patents, or chemical structure images.

  • Proficiency in Python for scientific programming, including hands-on experience with RDKit and working knowledge of SMILES and SMARTS.

  • Experience with retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or databases, including vector, graph, or SQL databases.

  • Strong working knowledge of molecular chemistry sufficient to assess the validity of proposed molecules and extracted structures.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across scientific and engineering disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building MCP servers or custom APIs for agent tool use.

  • Experience with optical chemical structure recognition (image-to-SMILES) or Markush structure handling.

  • Experience with agent memory, multi-agent coordination, or agent-evaluation methods.

  • Experience fine-tuning or distilling language models, including small models for domain-specific tasks.

  • Experience with chemistry-specific language models or generative molecular design.

  • Background in molecular chemistry, organic electronics, OLED materials, or organic semiconductors.

  • Experience with patent-literature analysis or prior-art search.

  • Experience deploying AI systems in secure or isolated computing environments.

Current Benefits at UDC:

  • Competitive base salary and annual bonus program

  • Medical/Prescription Drug coverage, Dental, and Vision for employees and family

  • Option of Health and Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

  • Option of Health Savings Account (HSA)

  • 401(k) company contribution

  • Ewing Worldwide Headquarters (HQ) cafeteria provides breakfast and lunch to employees at no cost to them

  • Annual charitable matching gift

  • Generous Paid Time Off

Annual compensation range: $115k-140k

title: Research Scientist - MLIPs and Model Architectures
description:
At Universal Display Corporation (Nasdaq: OLED) (UDC), we’re changing the way people see the world.

If you’re reading this on a smartphone, there’s a good chance UDC’s materials are producing the light and color shining from your screen right now. UDC’s OLED ingredients are key parts of stunning, energy-efficient displays used in everything from smartwatches to phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, TVs and automobiles. Virtually every OLED consumer electronics product around the world uses UDC’s phosphorescent OLED materials and technologies.

UDC is a publicly traded company and pioneer in the OLED industry. When you join our global team, you are embarking on a journey at the forefront of display technology and organic electronics that impacts the daily lives of people around the world. From engineers to chemists, Ph.D. scientists, technicians, lawyers and more, our UDC team is continuously advancing our field. With a focus on energy efficiency, UDC’s team is contributing to making a better, more sustainable planet. Please visit us at .

Job Summary:
Universal Display Corporation is seeking a Research Scientist to develop and deploy machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and the neural network architectures that underpin them to accelerate molecular discovery and materials research. This role will design, train, and validate models that predict the energies, forces, and reactivity of organometallic and organic molecules at near-DFT accuracy, while developing new architectures for challenging properties. The position will contribute to a broader AI/ML and synthetic chemistry team advancing OLED chemistry across the discovery process, from ideation through synthesis and testing. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building MLIPs or equivariant neural networks, a strong foundation in computational chemistry, and the ability to collaborate with ML scientists, computational chemists, synthetic chemists, and device engineers to move new materials from concept toward experimental validation.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and evaluate machine-learned interatomic potentials for organometallic and organic materials, including multistate potentials for excited-state applications.

  • Develop and benchmark neural network architectures, including equivariant graph neural networks and graph transformers, for interatomic potentials and molecular property prediction.

  • Fine-tune foundation interatomic potentials using proprietary data, and build training sets efficiently through active learning and targeted DFT calculations.

  • Apply MLIPs to reactivity, degradation, and molecular-dynamics studies, including automated reaction-discovery workflows.

  • Integrate MLIPs and predictive models into agentic AI workflows and scientific applications that support chemistry-focused decision-making.

  • Curate DFT datasets and contribute to applied AI/ML infrastructure that enables reproducible model development, benchmarking, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Collaborate with ML scientists, computational chemists, synthetic chemists, and device engineers to interpret model outputs and guide modeling and architecture decisions.

Required Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience developing machine-learned interatomic potentials or ML force fields.

  • Proven experience designing or substantially modifying neural network architectures for molecular or atomistic systems, such as equivariant graph neural networks and related MLIP architectures (for example, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, UMA, AIMNet, or DPA).

  • Strong working knowledge of density functional theory, including the generation and quality assessment of training data.

  • Proficiency in Python for scientific programming, including hands-on experience with PyTorch, ASE, RDKit, and related scientific Python libraries.

  • Experience validating ML potentials beyond energy and force errors, including molecular-dynamics stability and out-of-distribution behavior.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across scientific and engineering disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced research experience applying MLIPs to transition-metal complexes, organometallic chemistry, reactive systems, or transition states.

  • Experience with excited-state, multistate, or multi-fidelity machine-learned potentials.

  • Experience fine-tuning foundation interatomic potentials or other pretrained atomistic models.

  • Experience with active learning, uncertainty quantification, or automated training-data generation for atomistic models.

  • Experience with molecular-dynamics and molecular-simulation workflows (for example, LAMMPS, OpenMM, or ASE), or enhanced-sampling techniques such as Nanoreactor.

  • Background in molecular chemistry, organic electronics, OLED materials, or organic semiconductors.

  • Experience with agentic AI workflows or LLM tool harnesses that connect models, tools, and data.

title: Principal, Mine Design
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Principal Engineer, Mine Design, to join our Technical Services & Capital Projects team. Reporting to the Manager, Studies, this role will provide technical expertise and oversight of mine design activities supporting Torex's development projects, with an initial focus on the Los Reyes Project in Mexico.

You will play a key role in ensuring the technical quality of mining studies, reviewing engineering designs, and working with internal teams and external consultants to develop safe, practical, and cost-effective mining solutions.

This position is based in Toronto, with a hybrid work arrangement and approximately 25% travel.

About Torex Gold

“Our purpose is to transform finite mineral resources into lasting prosperity

by positively impacting all the lives we touch.”

We are a Canadian mining company engaged in the exploration, development, and production of gold, copper, and silver from our flagship Morelos Complex in Guerrero, which is currently Mexico’s largest single gold producer. The Company also owns the advanced-stage Los Reyes gold-silver project in Sinaloa, Mexico, and a portfolio of early-stage exploration properties, including the Batopilas and Guigui projects in Chihuahua, Mexico, La Gloria in Sonora, Mexico, and the Medicine Springs project in Nevada, USA, as well as an option to acquire the Gryphon Summit project in Nevada, USA.

Torex consistently delivers on our commitments guided by our key strategic objectives: optimize Morelos production and costs; disciplined growth and capital allocation; grow reserves and resources; project delivery excellence; retain and attract best industry talent; and be an industry leader in responsible mining. In addition to realizing the full potential of the Morelos Property, the Company continues to seek opportunities to acquire assets that enable diversification and deliver value to shareholders.

We have proven over the past decade that we can make a positive impact on people’s lives and the environment around us, all while improving safety, achieving operational efficiencies, realizing cost reductions, and generating positive return on investment. This is what makes us strong. This is the Torex way.

What We're Looking for:

Qualifications:

  • University degree in Mining Engineering.
  • Additional certifications in Project Management or Operational Excellence, such as PMP or Six Sigma, are considered assets.

Experience & Skills

  • Approximately 15 years of progressive experience in hard rock mining, including at least five years of mining operations.
  • Strong technical expertise in mine design, planning, and scheduling, preferably in underground mining environments.
  • Proficiency in mine design software, with Deswik preferred. Experience with other mine design applications will be considered.
  • Experience in mining studies, engineering consulting, or technical project development, including exposure to technical studies, trade-off assessments, and financial considerations.
  • Ability to critically review mine designs, assess technical alternatives, and ensure engineering deliverables meet project requirements and safety standards.
  • Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with consultants, technical specialists, and project stakeholders.
  • Experience in mining operations in Mexico or Latin America and proficiency in Spanish are considered assets.

Key Accountabilities

Mining Design Aspects for New Projects

  • Develop and review mine designs, infrastructure layouts, production sequences, and technical alternatives to support mining studies and project development.
  • Evaluate engineering deliverables from external consultants, ensuring technical quality, operational feasibility, and consideration of capital and operating costs.
  • Integrate geological, geotechnical, ventilation, and other technical requirements into safe and practical mine designs.

Stakeholder Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal technical teams, external consultants, and project stakeholders to ensure alignment on mine design requirements and deliverables.
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations through design reviews, reports, and presentations to project leadership.

Mining Work Schedule

  • Support the timely delivery of mine design activities and technical studies, ensuring quality standards and project milestones are met.

Health & Safety

  • Integrate Safety in Design principles into mine designs and identify, communicate, and escalate technical and safety risks to project leadership.

Why Join Us?

  • Meaningful Work: Contribute to Torex's success and long-term growth through work that supports our business objectives and creates value for our stakeholders.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside experienced professionals who value teamwork, accountability, and mutual respect.
  • Commitment to Responsible Mining: Be part of a company focused on operating responsibly and making a positive impact on the communities where we operate.
  • Competitive Total Rewards
    • Annual Base Salary: CAD$160,000- CAD$210,000
    • Short-term incentive plan and long-term incentives
    • Extended group health and dental plans
    • Health Care Spending Account of $1,000 per year
    • Insurance coverage (Life, AD&D, STD, and LTD)
    • RRSP matching
    • Wellness initiatives, ongoing development, and career growth opportunities
    • Four weeks of vacation for everyone
    • Flexible work arrangements

Join us in shaping the future of Torex Resources!

The posted salary range represents our target pay for this role. Final compensation will be determined based on the comprehensive review of the candidate’s qualifications, skills, and experience, as well as internal equity and external benchmark data for comparable roles.

This posting is for an existing vacancy that the Company is actively recruiting to fill.

Please note that Torex Resources does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies without a created agreement in place for permanent/contract placements.

Torex Resources is an equal-opportunity employer. We are proud to provide employment accommodation during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please indicate this when you apply, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
