description:
Role: Senior Software Security Engineer

Location: San Diego, CA (in-office)

Salary Range: $170,000 - $230,000 / yr + stock options, 401k matching, and other benefits

Role Overview:

At Seasats, our USVs operate for months at a time, thousands of miles from shore, carrying data that defense, scientific, and commercial customers depend on. The software behind those vehicles, from the code running on board to the cloud platforms and web applications that manage the fleet, has to be protected as carefully as the hardware.

We're looking for a Senior Software Security Engineer to be the security owner for our software team. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll review designs and code, build security into how we develop and ship software, respond when something goes wrong, and write fixes yourself when that's the fastest way to close a gap. You'll also take point on efforts like our authorization (ATO) work with Department of War (DoW) customers. We see security as an ongoing process rather than a finish line, so we're looking for someone who works with the team to navigate trade-offs, stays flexible about what can't all happen at once, and weighs cost and risk to decide what to tackle first. If you like being the person who makes the whole team's software harder to break, this is a great fit.

Role Details:

As a senior member of the team, you'll help inform technical direction and raise the bar for how we build secure software at Seasats. On a day-to-day / week-to-week basis, you will:

  • Own the security posture of our software across vehicle software, cloud platforms, and customer-facing web applications
  • Perform security reviews of code, architecture, and designs, and partner with other engineers to fix issues rather than just report them
  • Integrate security tooling (static analysis, dependency and container scanning, secrets detection, SBOM generation) into our CI/CD pipelines, then triage findings and drive them to closure
  • Lead threat modeling for new features and systems, and help the team make secure design decisions early
  • Plan and coordinate security testing, including penetration tests and vulnerability assessments, and own remediation through to closure
  • Take point on customer-driven security efforts, such as our ATO and authorization work with DoW customers, translating requirements into concrete changes in our software
  • Develop and run incident response processes for our software and infrastructure
  • Help set security standards and mentor other engineers on secure development practices

About You:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software security, application security, or software engineering with a security focus
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, C/C++, Javascript, or similar) and the ability to read, review, and modify production code
  • Hands-on experience with security tooling such as static/dynamic analysis, dependency and container scanning, and vulnerability scanners
  • Experience performing secure code reviews and threat modeling for production systems
  • Demonstrated ability to work with engineering teams to drive vulnerabilities to remediation
  • Experience supporting security compliance or authorization efforts (e.g., RMF/ATO, NIST SP 800-53/171, STIGs, or similar frameworks)
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup where security has to fit the stage of the company: you prioritize the risks that matter most, accept reasonable tradeoffs, and don’t need a perfect process before making progress
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with customers and assessors
  • Able to obtain a U.S. security clearance

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in defense or other high-assurance environments, including taking systems through DoW authorization
  • Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments
  • Experience with embedded, robotics, or vehicle/edge software security (e.g., secure boot, key management, OTA update integrity)
  • Experience with incident response, penetration testing, or red team work
  • Experience with GovCloud, FedRAMP, or CMMC environments
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CSSLP, Security+, GIAC, or equivalent)

About Seasats:

At Seasats, we're passionate about delivering maritime robotics solutions to redefine the maritime industry. Our primary products are unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), designed to carry sensors at sea for months at a time. Our USVs provide persistent monitoring and data acquisition to defense, scientific, and commercial customers, and have autonomously crossed both the Pacific and Atlantic oceans. After thousands of years in which the only way to gather information from the ocean was to put people on a boat, these uncrewed vessels are transforming how humanity monitors and interacts with the ocean. Here, you'll find the space and opportunity to do your life's best work.

Along with your salary, you'll receive perks including:

  • 401k matching up to 4% of salary
  • Four free lunches per week

  • A pet-friendly office
  • Unlimited/Flex PTO

title: QA QC Manager CWI
description:
QA/QC Manager / Lead CWI

Location: Phoenix, Arizona – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $50.00–$65.00 per hour, depending on experience

Schedule / Work Environment: Full-time, onsite quality leadership position. Schedule and hours may vary based on construction activities, inspection requirements, testing, turnover schedules, and client needs.

Job Summary

Greenberry Industrial is seeking an experienced QA/QC Manager / Lead Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) to lead quality assurance and quality control activities for piping, welding, mechanical equipment installation, and related construction scopes at a high-tech semiconductor facility in Phoenix, Arizona.

This position is responsible for implementing and maintaining project quality requirements while providing senior technical leadership for welding and piping inspection activities. The QA/QC Manager / Lead CWI will work closely with Project Management, Superintendents, General Foremen, craft leadership, client quality representatives, engineering, subcontractors, and third-party inspection personnel to ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, codes, welding procedures, inspection requirements, and client standards.

Candidates must have 10+ years of QA/QC experience in industrial construction and hold a current AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification. Strong experience with piping fabrication and installation, welding inspection, weld procedures, welder qualifications, material traceability, NDE/NDT coordination, pressure testing, and turnover documentation is required.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with field construction teams and capable of balancing rigorous quality requirements with the practical demands of a fast-paced construction environment.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Program Leadership

  • Lead day-to-day QA/QC activities for assigned project scopes.
  • Implement and maintain the project Quality Control Plan, inspection processes, procedures, and documentation requirements.
  • Establish clear quality expectations for Project Management, field supervision, craft personnel, subcontractors, and inspectors.
  • Review contract documents, drawings, specifications, codes, client standards, and quality requirements.
  • Develop and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) as required by the project.
  • Coordinate quality hold points, witness points, inspections, testing, and documentation.
  • Provide technical guidance to field leadership regarding applicable quality requirements.
  • Identify quality risks early and develop strategies to prevent defects and rework.
  • Lead quality meetings and communicate project quality performance, issues, and corrective actions.
  • Support client audits, internal audits, surveillance activities, and quality reviews.
  • Lead and mentor Quality Inspectors, CWIs, and other assigned quality personnel.

Welding Quality & CWI Responsibilities

  • Provide senior CWI oversight of structural and piping welding activities.
  • Verify welding operations comply with applicable codes, project specifications, approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPSs), and client requirements.
  • Review and maintain WPSs, Procedure Qualification Records (PQRs), and Welder Performance Qualification Records (WPQRs) as applicable.
  • Verify welder qualifications are current and appropriate for the processes, materials, positions, and work being performed.
  • Perform or oversee visual inspection of weld preparation, fit-up, in-process welding, and completed welds.
  • Verify proper joint preparation, alignment, root openings, consumables, preheat, interpass temperatures, and other welding requirements.
  • Monitor welding consumable handling, storage, issuance, and control.
  • Coordinate weld mapping, weld identification, inspection status, reject rates, and repair documentation.
  • Review weld defects and support determination of appropriate repair requirements.
  • Work directly with field leadership to reduce weld rejection rates and prevent recurring quality issues.

Piping Quality & Inspection

  • Oversee quality activities associated with process piping, utility piping, high-purity piping, valves, supports, and equipment connections.
  • Verify piping installations conform to approved drawings, P&IDs, piping isometrics, specifications, system requirements, and applicable codes.
  • Verify correct materials, fittings, valves, components, orientation, routing, slopes, supports, and installation requirements.
  • Maintain material identification and traceability requirements where applicable.
  • Coordinate inspection of piping fit-up, welding, supports, bolting, equipment connections, and completed installations.
  • Review documentation for installed piping systems and identify missing or incomplete quality records.
  • Coordinate punch-list resolution and system completion activities.
  • Support mechanical completion, turnover, and commissioning readiness.

NDE/NDT & Testing Coordination

  • Coordinate required nondestructive examination/testing activities with qualified technicians and third-party providers.
  • Review NDE/NDT reports and verify results meet project and code requirements.
  • Track required examination percentages, weld status, rejects, repairs, and re-examinations.
  • Coordinate radiographic, ultrasonic, liquid penetrant, magnetic particle, and other examinations as applicable to project requirements.
  • Coordinate pressure testing, leak testing, flushing, cleaning, and related piping-system testing activities.
  • Review test packages to verify systems are properly prepared prior to testing.
  • Verify testing documentation is complete and acceptable before system turnover.

Nonconformance & Corrective Action

  • Identify and document work that does not conform to drawings, specifications, codes, procedures, or client requirements.
  • Initiate and manage Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) and associated corrective actions.
  • Work with Project Management, engineering, field leadership, and client representatives to resolve quality issues.
  • Track NCRs through final disposition and closure.
  • Conduct root-cause reviews for significant or recurring quality issues.
  • Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize recurrence.
  • Monitor rework trends and communicate areas of concern to project leadership.
  • Promote a proactive quality culture focused on preventing issues rather than simply identifying defects after installation.

Documentation & Turnover

  • Ensure complete, accurate, and traceable quality records are maintained throughout construction.
  • Maintain weld logs, welder qualification records, inspection reports, material documentation, NDE reports, testing records, NCRs, and other required quality records.
  • Review turnover packages for accuracy and completeness.
  • Coordinate documentation requirements with Project Management, Document Control, commissioning teams, and client quality personnel.
  • Support system turnover, mechanical completion, commissioning, and final acceptance.
  • Ensure required quality documentation is completed and submitted in accordance with project and client requirements.

Field & Client Coordination

  • Maintain a strong field presence and work directly with Superintendents, General Foremen, Foremen, and craft personnel.
  • Participate in construction planning meetings, coordination meetings, and client quality meetings.
  • Serve as a primary quality interface with client representatives and third-party inspection personnel.
  • Communicate quality issues clearly and professionally while maintaining productive working relationships.
  • Coordinate inspection requirements with construction schedules to minimize avoidable delays.
  • Ensure upcoming work is appropriately planned for required inspections, hold points, and documentation.

Safety & Compliance

  • Perform all quality activities in accordance with Greenberry Industrial safety policies, OSHA requirements, and client-specific site requirements.
  • Coordinate inspections and testing activities safely around active construction operations.
  • Maintain compliance with site requirements for access, security, cleanliness, permits, PPE, and controlled work areas.
  • Immediately communicate unsafe conditions identified during field inspections.
  • Partner with Safety and Operations to ensure quality activities support safe execution rather than create conflicting field requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive QA/QC experience within industrial construction, piping fabrication, mechanical construction, semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, energy, petrochemical, or similarly complex environments.
  • Current AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification.
  • Extensive knowledge of welding inspection and industrial piping construction.
  • Strong knowledge of WPSs, PQRs, welder qualifications, weld mapping, inspection requirements, and welding documentation.
  • Experience with NDE/NDT coordination and interpretation of inspection reports.
  • Experience with piping inspection, material verification and traceability, pressure testing, system completion, and turnover.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, piping isometrics, specifications, welding documentation, and quality requirements.
  • Experience developing and implementing inspection plans and quality-control processes.
  • Experience managing NCRs, corrective actions, inspection documentation, and turnover packages.
  • Strong documentation, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with craft employees, field leadership, Project Management, engineering, clients, and inspectors.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Phoenix, Arizona.

Preferred

  • Previous experience supporting semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, cleanroom, advanced manufacturing, pharmaceutical, or mission-critical construction.
  • Experience with process piping, high-purity piping, specialty gases, process utilities, stainless steel piping, and mechanical equipment installation.
  • Previous experience serving as a QA/QC Manager, Quality Manager, Lead CWI, or Senior Quality Inspector on a large industrial project.
  • Experience supervising CWIs and other quality personnel.
  • Familiarity with applicable piping and welding standards such as ASME B31.3, ASME Section IX, and AWS requirements, as applicable to the assigned project.
  • Additional NDE/NDT certifications or documented inspection qualifications are desirable.
  • Experience working within client-controlled facilities with rigorous cleanliness, documentation, traceability, and turnover requirements.

Physical Requirements

This position requires regular presence in an active construction environment. The employee must be able to:

  • Perform physical work associated with construction inspection and field quality activities.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday, including on uneven construction surfaces.
  • Climb stairs and ladders and access elevated construction areas as required to perform inspections.
  • Bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach, and work in varying positions while inspecting piping, welds, equipment, and construction activities.
  • Safely lift and carry inspection equipment, materials, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Work indoors and outdoors and in varying environmental conditions.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment while working in designated construction areas.
  • Safely perform inspection activities around active welding, piping installation, heavy equipment, rigging, and other construction operations.

Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $50.00–$65.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Full-time employment with Greenberry Industrial.
  • Opportunity to lead quality operations on a large, high-profile semiconductor construction project.
  • Opportunity for continued advancement within Greenberry's Quality and Construction organizations.

Where this position or portions of the work are subject to prevailing-wage requirements, wages and applicable fringe benefits will be administered in accordance with the applicable wage determination, employee classification, project requirements, and applicable law.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Digital Specialist
description:
Kelly Scott Madison—KSM—is a leading, independent media and advertising agency that future-proofs brands and fuels business growth. Our team of strategists, solutionists, technologists, and data analysts work united with incredible brand partners, helping them connect with customers in more meaningful ways today and positioning them to move with the customers of tomorrow. The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Specialist, Digital Investment, with Paid Social expertise to support the day-to-day activation, management, optimization, and reporting of cross-channel digital campaigns. You will help translate client objectives into thoughtful tactical recommendations, ensure accurate execution across platforms, and use performance data to identify opportunities that improve campaign outcomes. Working closely with senior team members and agency partners, you will build platform expertise, contribute to strong client service, and help advance KSM’s digital investment practice through reliable execution, continuous learning, and process improvement.

The Ways You Will Make an Impact

  • Support the end-to-end setup, launch, management, optimization, and reporting of campaigns across paid social platforms. A plus if you have cross-channel experience in paid search and/or programmatic as well!

  • Contribute to platform-specific investment recommendations that connect client business objectives and audience insights that ladder to the broader media strategy.

  • Monitor pacing, delivery, quality, and performance; identify risks early and partner with senior team members to take action to protect budgets, timelines, and campaign outcomes.

  • Analyze performance data to explain what happened, why it matters, and what the team or client should do next; contribute to optimization strategies, testing plans, and tactical recommendations.

  • Partner closely with Integrated Planning, Analytics & Insights, Ad Operations, Finance, and creative teams to ensure continuity from strategy through activation, measurement, and billing.

  • Build strong working relationships with platform partners, sales representatives, clients, and internal stakeholders through proactive, accurate, and solutions-oriented communication.

  • Collaborate with associates and senior team members, communicate task status clearly, and review assigned work carefully to support accurate, timely deliverables.

  • Develop and share best practices, platform updates, and marketplace POVs across search, social, and programmatic; contribute to training and cross-channel upskilling.

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, automation, and quality controls while maintaining appropriate human judgment and accountability.

Experience You Should Bring

  • 1–3 years of hands-on digital media investment experience across paid social. Plus if you have paid search, and/or programmatic experience, ideally within an agency environment.

  • Experience on financial accounts preferred, but not required.

  • Experience supporting or managing multi-platform campaigns, including setup, trafficking coordination, pacing, optimization, reporting, and reconciliation.

  • Ability to translate business objectives and performance data into clear insights, implications, and actionable investment recommendations.

  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as The Trade Desk, Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, or comparable tools; The Trade Desk experience is strongly preferred.

  • Experience supporting media budgets and multiple campaigns, timelines, stakeholders, and priorities with strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Experience collaborating within a team, managing assigned responsibilities, and communicating progress or risks proactively.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including comfort working with large datasets, pivot tables, lookups, and performance analyses.

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the confidence to communicate recommendations, risks, and results to internal partners and clients.

  • Working knowledge of digital media measurement, attribution, brand safety, privacy, and evolving platform and industry standards.

How You Think & Work

• You use sound judgment and take ownership: You balance speed, accuracy, and impact, make informed recommendations, and remain accountable from initial setup through final reporting and billing.

• You see both the details and the bigger picture: You are comfortable working in-platform while understanding how investment decisions connect to the client objective, audience, creative, measurement plan, and broader media strategy.

• You communicate early and clearly: You surface risks, explain the why behind your recommendations, and build trust through accuracy, confidence, follow-through, and transparency.

• You are a dependable teammate: You communicate progress, follow through on commitments, seek feedback, and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

• You are analytical and curious: You ask better questions, interrogate performance, and use data to identify patterns, test ideas, and improve outcomes.

• You adapt as the marketplace evolves: You stay current on platforms, tools, privacy changes, and emerging opportunities, then translate what matters into practical action.

• You make the work better: You respect the fundamentals while simplifying recurring work, strengthening quality controls, and creating more capacity for strategic thinking and client impact.

Benefits we offer:

We've got you covered -- and we’re not just referring to robust health insurance. To us, coverage is about supporting your full experience and whole self, from inclusive benefits, flexibility, and an appreciation for time away, to recognition, professional development, and growth opportunities.

  • Talent Enablement: Career pathing, integrated learning ecosystem, mentorship, and employee recognition

  • Financial: Competitive compensation, 401(k) with company match, pre-tax programs, referral rewards, and a remote work reimbursement

  • Wellness: Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision, pet, and life), onsite fitness center covered 100%, discounted membership rates at partner gyms and access to virtual fitness classes, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and curated opportunities to nurture your breaktime

  • Balance: Personalized Paid Time Off (i.e., “Unlimited PTO”), remote work flexibility, paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, and adoption), and a variety of Employee Resource Groups

  • Giving Back: Volunteer opportunities and corporate donation matching through KSM Cares Outreach, our Corporate Social Responsibility program

Ideal for an individual seeking an entry-level position in corporate governance and/or investment stewardship.

As a member of the Proxy Research team, you will conduct corporate governance research on publicly-listed companies in mainland China and/or on the Taiwan Stock Exchange and make draft recommendations to institutional investors on how they should vote at their portfolio companies' shareholder meetings. You will comb through publicly disclosed information (e.g. stock exchange announcements including annual reports and notices of meeting, company press releases, news articles, etc.) to collect corporate governance-related data on each company to which you have been assigned. Then, working under close supervision from the team's analysts, you will analyse each company's governance practices within a policy-based framework of market best practices. The bulk of your time will be spent analysing company board and governance structures and reviewing proposals up for vote at shareholder meetings. This role does not involve a significant amount of quantitative analysis but requires an ability to understand and identify what is being disclosed as much as what is being omitted.

This is an excellent opportunity to learn about corporate governance frameworks, to research publicly-traded companies, including their directors, and to work at the forefront of the corporate governance and investment stewardship field.

Required
  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a related field such as corporate law, accounting or finance.

Preferred
  • Business level proficiency in English and the ability to read both Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

  • Work experience conducting qualitative analysis and writing research reports.
  • A keen interest in corporate governance issues at listed companies will be looked upon favourably. This may include company board structures, director independence, employee incentive plans, and capital raisings.

title: QC Tech
description:
Quality Control Technician (QC Tech)

Location: Phoenix, Arizona – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $40.00–$50.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications

Reports To: QA/QC Manager / Lead CWI

Schedule / Work Environment: Full-time, onsite field quality position. Schedule and hours may vary based on construction activities, inspection requirements, testing, turnover schedules, and client needs.

Job Summary

Greenberry Industrial is seeking an experienced Quality Control Technician (QC Tech) to support piping, welding, mechanical equipment installation, and related construction activities at a high-tech semiconductor facility in Phoenix, Arizona.

The QC Technician will perform field inspections, maintain quality documentation, verify construction activities meet project requirements, and work closely with the QA/QC Manager, Project Management, Superintendents, Foremen, craft personnel, and client quality representatives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on industrial construction quality experience and a strong working knowledge of piping fabrication and installation, welding, material verification, inspection documentation, testing, and turnover requirements. AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification is preferred but not required.

This is a field-based position requiring regular interaction with construction crews and the ability to identify and document quality issues while helping the project team achieve compliant, right-the-first-time installations.

Key Responsibilities

Field Quality Inspection

  • Perform routine field inspections of piping, welding, equipment installation, supports, and related construction activities.
  • Verify construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, procedures, applicable codes, and client requirements.
  • Inspect piping layout, routing, orientation, supports, valves, fittings, and equipment connections.
  • Review piping isometrics, P&IDs, spool drawings, specifications, and other construction documents in support of inspections.
  • Verify work is ready for required inspections, hold points, testing, and client acceptance.
  • Document inspection results accurately and communicate deficiencies to appropriate field and quality leadership.
  • Conduct regular field walks and maintain close coordination with Foremen and craft personnel.
  • Assist with punch-list development, tracking, verification, and closure.

Welding Quality

  • Support inspection of piping and structural welding activities.
  • Verify applicable Welding Procedure Specifications (WPSs) are available and being followed.
  • Verify welder qualifications are appropriate for the work being performed.
  • Perform visual inspection of weld preparation, fit-up, in-process welding, and completed welds when qualified to do so.
  • Monitor joint preparation, alignment, welding consumables, preheat, and other applicable welding requirements.
  • Assist with weld identification, weld mapping, inspection status, and documentation.
  • Identify visible weld discontinuities and escalate potential nonconforming conditions to the Lead CWI or QA/QC Manager.
  • Assist with tracking weld repairs, rejection rates, and completed inspections.

Piping & Material Control

  • Verify piping materials, fittings, valves, and components against project requirements prior to installation.
  • Support material identification and traceability requirements.
  • Verify proper component installation, orientation, supports, and system configuration.
  • Identify damaged, incorrect, or nonconforming materials and communicate concerns before installation.
  • Support verification of piping system completeness prior to testing.
  • Assist with maintaining material documentation and associated quality records.

NDE/NDT & Testing Support

  • Coordinate field access and inspection readiness for required NDE/NDT activities.
  • Assist with tracking radiographic, ultrasonic, liquid penetrant, magnetic particle, and other examination requirements as applicable.
  • Maintain logs for completed examinations, results, repairs, and re-examinations.
  • Support pressure testing, leak testing, flushing, cleaning, and other required system-testing activities.
  • Verify test boundaries, documentation, and inspection requirements are satisfied prior to scheduled testing.
  • Assist the QA/QC Manager / Lead CWI in reviewing and maintaining testing records.

Nonconformance & Corrective Action

  • Identify work that does not conform to approved drawings, specifications, procedures, or project quality requirements.
  • Document quality concerns clearly and accurately.
  • Assist with development and tracking of Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) as directed.
  • Verify corrective work is completed and appropriately reinspected.
  • Communicate recurring quality concerns to the QA/QC Manager / Lead CWI.
  • Work constructively with field leadership to identify issues early and reduce rework.

Quality Documentation & Turnover

  • Maintain accurate and organized project quality records.
  • Update weld logs, inspection reports, testing documentation, NDE records, punch lists, and other project quality trackers.
  • Assist with compiling piping and mechanical turnover packages.
  • Verify required inspection and quality records are complete before systems are submitted for turnover.
  • Work with Quality, Project Management, Document Control, and field teams to obtain missing documentation.
  • Support mechanical completion, commissioning, turnover, and final project closeout activities.

Safety & Field Coordination

  • Perform inspection activities in accordance with Greenberry Industrial safety policies, OSHA requirements, and client-specific requirements.
  • Follow all site requirements related to PPE, access, security, cleanliness, permits, and controlled construction areas.
  • Coordinate inspections with field leadership to avoid unnecessarily disrupting construction activities.
  • Communicate unsafe conditions identified during field inspections.
  • Maintain professional working relationships with craft personnel, field leadership, clients, third-party inspectors, and other project stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Previous quality control, inspection, welding, piping, fabrication, or related industrial construction experience.
  • Working knowledge of industrial/process piping and welding construction practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, piping isometrics, construction drawings, specifications, and inspection documentation.
  • Understanding of welding procedures, welder qualifications, visual inspection practices, and basic weld-quality requirements.
  • Experience maintaining inspection and construction-quality documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping.
  • Ability to communicate quality concerns professionally with field leadership and craft personnel.
  • Ability to prioritize inspections and documentation in a fast-paced construction environment.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and electronic document-management systems.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Phoenix, Arizona.

Preferred

  • Current AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification.
  • Experience on semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, pharmaceutical, data center, cleanroom, or mission-critical construction projects.
  • Experience inspecting process piping, high-purity piping, stainless steel piping, specialty gases, process utilities, and mechanical equipment installations.
  • Familiarity with ASME B31.3 and ASME Section IX as applicable to project piping and welding activities.
  • Experience working with WPSs, PQRs, welder qualifications, weld maps, and weld logs.
  • Experience coordinating NDE/NDT and reviewing associated documentation.
  • Familiarity with material traceability, pressure testing, inspection test plans, NCRs, mechanical completion, and turnover packages.
  • Additional welding, NDE/NDT, or quality-related certifications are a plus.

Physical Requirements

This position requires regular presence in an active construction environment. The employee must be able to:

  • Perform physical work associated with construction inspection and field quality activities.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods, including on uneven construction surfaces.
  • Climb stairs and ladders and access elevated construction areas as required to perform inspections.
  • Bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and reach while inspecting piping, welds, equipment, and other construction activities.
  • Safely lift and carry inspection equipment, tools, materials, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Work indoors and outdoors and in varying environmental conditions.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment while working in designated construction areas.
  • Safely perform inspection activities around active welding, piping installation, equipment installation, rigging, and other construction operations.

Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $40.00–$50.00 per hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and applicable certifications.
  • Full-time employment with Greenberry Industrial.
  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunity to support a large, high-profile semiconductor construction project.
  • Career development opportunities within Greenberry's Quality and Construction organizations.

Where this position or portions of the work are subject to prevailing-wage requirements, wages and applicable fringe benefits will be administered in accordance with the applicable wage determination, employee classification, project requirements, and applicable law.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Greenberry Industrial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Piping Foreman
description:
Piping Foreman

Location: Phoenix, Arizona – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $74.00 per hour plus applicable prevailing-wage fringe benefits

Reports To: Piping General Foreman / Piping Superintendent

Schedule / Work Environment: Full-time, onsite field leadership position. Schedule and hours may vary based on project requirements, critical-path activities, scheduled overtime, shutdowns, and client needs.

Job Summary

Greenberry Industrial is seeking an experienced Piping Foreman to lead piping installation activities at a high-tech semiconductor facility in Phoenix, Arizona.

The Piping Foreman is responsible for the safe, productive, and high-quality execution of assigned piping work and provides direct day-to-day leadership to Pipefitters, Welders, and other assigned craft personnel. This individual will coordinate closely with the Piping General Foreman and Superintendent to plan work, assign manpower, maintain productivity, ensure material and tool readiness, and complete work in accordance with project drawings, specifications, schedules, and quality requirements.

Candidates must have at least 5 years of piping construction experience, including 2+ years in a field leadership role. The successful candidate will bring strong hands-on knowledge of industrial/process piping, pipefitting, welding operations, piping supports, equipment connections, testing, and field construction practices.

This is an active, hands-on leadership role requiring significant time in the field directing crews and ensuring work is completed safely, correctly, and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

Crew Leadership & Field Execution

  • Direct and supervise Pipefitters, Welders, helpers, and other assigned craft personnel.
  • Lead daily piping construction activities and ensure crews understand work assignments, priorities, production expectations, and safety requirements.
  • Assign work based on employee skills, qualifications, project priorities, and scheduled activities.
  • Maintain a strong field presence and provide hands-on leadership and technical direction to craft employees.
  • Monitor crew productivity and installed quantities and communicate progress to the Piping General Foreman and Superintendent.
  • Identify field constraints and take proactive steps to prevent work disruptions.
  • Maintain crew accountability for safety, quality, productivity, attendance, and workmanship.
  • Coordinate with other Foremen and trades to sequence work and avoid field conflicts.

Piping Installation & Technical Execution

  • Lead installation of industrial process piping, utility piping, valves, fittings, supports, hangers, equipment connections, and related piping systems.
  • Read and interpret piping isometrics, P&IDs, spool drawings, plans, specifications, and other construction documents.
  • Verify proper piping layout, location, elevation, orientation, routing, supports, and equipment connections.
  • Direct pipe layout, fit-up, fabrication, installation, and welding activities.
  • Verify piping components and materials are appropriate for the assigned system before installation.
  • Identify drawing conflicts, constructability concerns, interferences, and field discrepancies and communicate them to project leadership.
  • Coordinate piping tie-ins and critical installation activities.
  • Support pressure testing, system cleaning, flushing, inspection, commissioning, and turnover activities.
  • Ensure assigned work is completed in accordance with project drawings, specifications, applicable codes, and client requirements.

Planning & Productivity

  • Participate in daily and weekly planning with the General Foreman and Superintendent.
  • Review upcoming work and identify required manpower, materials, tools, equipment, access, permits, and information.
  • Develop daily crew work plans and clearly communicate expectations before work begins.
  • Monitor labor hours, installed quantities, and crew productivity.
  • Identify conditions negatively affecting productivity and escalate issues promptly.
  • Minimize craft downtime through proper planning and workface preparation.
  • Coordinate with project leadership to maintain alignment with construction schedules and project milestones.
  • Assist with short-interval planning and look-ahead schedules.

Material & Tool Coordination

  • Verify required piping materials, fittings, valves, supports, consumables, tools, and equipment are available before starting work.
  • Coordinate material staging and distribution to the crew.
  • Identify shortages, incorrect materials, or damaged materials and report them promptly.
  • Maintain appropriate control of company tools and construction equipment.
  • Coordinate required lifts, scaffolding, access equipment, and other resources supporting piping activities.
  • Maintain organized work areas and promote efficient material handling.

Quality & Welding

  • Ensure piping installations meet Greenberry Industrial, client, engineering, and project quality requirements.
  • Work closely with Quality personnel to coordinate required inspections and documentation.
  • Ensure Welders and Pipefitters follow approved procedures and project specifications.
  • Support proper weld identification, inspection, testing, and documentation.
  • Verify fit-up and installation quality before work progresses to subsequent activities.
  • Assist with pressure testing, punch-list work, system completion, and turnover.
  • Immediately address workmanship issues and minimize rework through effective supervision.
  • Reinforce expectations that work is completed correctly the first time.

Safety Leadership

  • Lead by example and maintain a safety-first approach to all piping construction activities.
  • Enforce Greenberry Industrial safety policies, OSHA requirements, client requirements, and site-specific safety procedures.
  • Lead daily pre-task planning and ensure employees understand hazards and required controls before starting work.
  • Conduct toolbox talks and participate in project safety meetings.
  • Monitor crew activities for unsafe conditions or behaviors and immediately address identified concerns.
  • Stop work when conditions cannot be safely controlled.
  • Reinforce proper PPE, fall protection, hot-work, lifting and rigging, elevated-work, and line-of-fire requirements.
  • Coordinate with Safety personnel and project leadership to proactively address field hazards.

Semiconductor Facility Coordination

  • Lead piping activities within a highly controlled semiconductor construction environment.
  • Ensure crews comply with client requirements for site access, security, safety, cleanliness, work-area controls, permitting, and documentation.
  • Maintain strong housekeeping and material-control standards.
  • Coordinate piping work with equipment installation, mechanical, structural, electrical, controls, and other interfacing trades.
  • Support work occurring around active operations, sensitive equipment, restricted areas, and critical construction zones.
  • Assist with planned shutdowns, piping tie-ins, and critical installation windows as required.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 5+ years of piping construction experience in industrial, manufacturing, semiconductor, high-tech, energy, or similarly complex construction environments.
  • 2+ years of construction leadership experience as a Piping Foreman, Lead Pipefitter, Leadman, or comparable field leadership position.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of industrial/process piping installation.
  • Strong understanding of pipefitting, welding, valves, piping supports, equipment connections, and piping system construction.
  • Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, piping isometrics, spool drawings, plans, and specifications.
  • Experience supervising Pipefitters, Welders, and other piping craft personnel.
  • Ability to plan daily work, coordinate manpower, and maintain productive crew performance.
  • Strong understanding of field construction safety requirements.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with craft personnel, field supervision, Quality, Safety, and Project Management.
  • Strong field leadership, organization, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Phoenix, Arizona.

Preferred

  • Previous semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, cleanroom, pharmaceutical, advanced manufacturing, or mission-critical construction experience.
  • Experience with process piping, high-purity piping, process utilities, specialty piping, and mechanical equipment installation.
  • Experience working with stainless steel and other specialty piping materials.
  • Familiarity with welding procedures, weld documentation, material traceability, NDE/NDT, pressure testing, inspection, and turnover requirements.
  • Experience working in highly controlled operating or construction environments.
  • Experience coordinating piping work with mechanical equipment, structural, electrical, controls, and other field trades.

Physical Requirements

This is an active field construction position. The employee must be able to:

  • Perform physical work associated with industrial piping installation and construction activities.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday, including on uneven construction surfaces.
  • Climb stairs and ladders and access elevated work areas as required.
  • Bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach, and work in varying positions associated with piping construction.
  • Safely lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Work indoors and outdoors and in varying temperature and environmental conditions.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment for the duration of work in designated construction areas.
  • Safely work around active construction operations, heavy equipment, welding activities, piping systems, and other industrial hazards.

Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $74.00 per hour.
  • Applicable fringe benefits provided in accordance with prevailing-wage requirements.
  • Full-time employment with Greenberry Industrial.
  • Opportunity to work on a large, high-profile semiconductor construction project.
  • Opportunity for continued career advancement into Piping General Foreman, Piping Superintendent, and broader field leadership positions.

Actual wages and applicable fringe benefits will be administered in accordance with the applicable prevailing-wage determination, employee classification, project requirements, and applicable law.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Contribute to C++ and Python software used for compute-intensive and distributed workloads. Learn how applications are built, tested, deployed, and monitored on Linux and Windows HPC systems. Assist with profiling, debugging, and improving software performance, scalability, and resource utilization. Gain practical exposure to workload schedulers such as Slurm, LSF, or PBS. Help package and run applications using container technologies such as Docker; explore Kubernetes where relevant. Write automated tests, developer tools, scripts, and technical documentation. Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and team demonstrations with guidance from experienced engineers. Collaborate with software, infrastructure, DevOps, and product teams in an international R&D environment. Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field. Coursework, projects, research, or prior internship experience using C++, Python, or both. Basic experience working in Linux, including using a shell and common development tools. Understanding of core software engineering concepts such as data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, testing, and version control. Interest in parallel computing, distributed systems, cloud computing, scientific software, or performance engineering. Ability to learn independently, ask good technical questions, and work effectively with a collaborative team. Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Affärssystemskonsult med affärsdriv och intresse för AI
description:
Vill du hjälpa kunder att få ut mer av sina affärssystem?

Vill du arbeta nära kunder, förstå deras verksamhet och hjälpa dem att hitta smartare och effektivare arbetssätt? Hos DataPartner, som är en del av ECIT koncernen, får du en bred konsultroll inom Visma/Spiris där du kombinerar affärssystem, ekonomi och kundrelationer med ett tydligt affärstänk.

Vi är Spiris största återförsäljare och har nyligen börjat utveckla AI lösningar kopplade till Visma/Spiris. Nu söker vi en affärssystemskonsult som vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss och våra kunder.


Om tjänsten

Som affärssystemskonsult hos DataPartner hjälper du små och medelstora företag att få ut mer av sina affärssystem. Du arbetar nära dina kunder och stöttar dem genom hela processen, från behovsanalys och implementering till utbildning, support och fortsatt utveckling.

Du sätter dig in i kundernas verksamhet och ekonomiprocesser och bygger långsiktiga relationer. Med god förståelse för både kundens behov och vår produktportfölj ser du möjligheter att utveckla kundens lösning vidare. På så sätt blir merförsäljning en naturlig del av konsultrollen.Det kan exempelvis handla om integrationer, automation, rapportering, Power BI eller AI-baserade lösningar.

Tjänsten utgår från våra nya, fina och centralt belägna kontor i Helsingborg eller Malmö. Det finns även möjlighet att kombinera kontoren och dela veckan mellan orterna.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • genomföra behovsanalyser och förstå kundens verksamhet och ekonomiprocesser

  • implementera och konfigurera lösningar inom Visma/Spiris

  • utbilda och vägleda kunder i hur de får ut mesta möjliga av sina system

  • utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer och identifiera möjligheter till merförsäljning

  • arbeta med integrationer, automation och rapportering för att skapa effektivare arbetssätt

  • använda AI-verktyg för att effektivisera ditt eget arbete

  • bidra till utvecklingen av DataPartners erbjudande inom AI kopplat till Visma/Spiris

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har minst tre års erfarenhet av affärssystem, exempelvis som konsult eller superuser, och som trivs i en konsultativ roll med mycket kundkontakt.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • god förståelse för ekonomi och ekonomiprocesser

  • mycket goda kunskaper i Excel

  • förmåga att förstå kundens verksamhet och identifiera utvecklings- och förbättringsmöjligheter

  • ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt och intresse för att utveckla befintliga kunder

  • erfarenhet av eller nyfikenhet på att använda AI-verktyg i ditt arbete

  • flytande svenska i tal och skrift

  • B-körkort

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Visma Administration/Spiris, arbete på redovisningsbyrå eller i en konsult- eller kundansvarig roll. Vi ser också gärna att du har arbetat med Power BI, Power Query, SQL, integrationer eller automation. Erfarenhet av AI-projekt eller AI-lösningar är meriterande, liksom förståelse för programmering och hur olika system samverkar.

För oss är din praktiska erfarenhet, affärsförståelse och förmåga att skapa värde för kunden viktigare än vilken examen du har.

Vem är du?

Du är nyfiken, affärsmässig och relationsskapande och tycker om att sätta dig in i hur kundens verksamhet fungerar på riktigt. Du nöjer dig inte med att lösa den aktuella frågan, utan ser gärna ett steg längre och funderar på hur kunden kan arbeta ännu smartare.

Du är pedagogisk och har lätt för att förklara system och lösningar på ett enkelt och begripligt sätt. Samtidigt är du självgående och bekväm med att ta ansvar för dina kunder och driva ditt arbete framåt.

För att trivas hos oss tror vi också att du är prestigelös och entreprenöriell. DataPartner är ett mindre team med korta beslutsvägar, vilket innebär att det finns goda möjligheter att komma med idéer, påverka och vara med och utveckla både arbetssätt och erbjudande.

Du behöver inte vara expert på AI idag. Däremot vill vi gärna att du är nyfiken på hur AI och automation kan användas för att skapa smartare arbetssätt och nya möjligheter för våra kunder.

Vad kan DataPartner erbjuda?

DataPartner har arbetat med affärssystem sedan 1992 och är idag Spiris största återförsäljare. Vi hjälper små och medelstora företag med Visma/Spiris, integrationer och automation samt rapportering och analys genom bland annat Power BI, Excel och Power Query.

Hos oss får du:

  • en bred konsultroll med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka och utveckla våra tjänster

  • arbeta nära dina kunder och följa deras utveckling över tid

  • kombinera affärssystem, ekonomi och teknik

  • vara med och utveckla vårt erbjudande inom AI och automation

  • bli en del av ett mindre, entreprenöriellt team med korta beslutsvägar

DataPartner är en del av ECIT-koncernen, en av Nordens större leverantörer av redovisning, lön och IT. ECIT har över 3 000 medarbetare i 11 länder. Här kombineras det mindre bolagets närhet och korta beslutsvägar med kompetensen, nätverket och resurserna hos en större internationell organisation.

Välkommen med din ansökan

Vill du utvecklas som affärssystemskonsult och samtidigt vara med och hjälpa våra kunder att arbeta smartare med Visma/Spiris, automation och AI? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Urval sker löpande. Tjänsten är på heltid och en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning.

Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt. Av GDPR-skäl tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.

Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

title: Piping General Foreman
description:
Piping General Foreman

Location: Phoenix, Arizona – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $76.00 per hour plus applicable prevailing-wage fringe benefits

Schedule / Work Environment: Full-time, onsite field leadership position. Schedule and hours may vary based on project requirements, critical-path activities, shutdowns, scheduled overtime, and client needs.

Job Summary

Greenberry Industrial is seeking an experienced Piping General Foreman to provide field leadership for piping and mechanical construction activities at a high-tech semiconductor facility in Phoenix, Arizona.

The Piping General Foreman is responsible for the safe, efficient, and productive execution of assigned piping scopes and will provide direct leadership to piping Foremen, Pipefitters, Welders, and other craft personnel. This position works closely with the Piping Superintendent, Project Management, Safety, Quality, Project Controls, and other construction disciplines to coordinate manpower, materials, equipment, work areas, priorities, and daily field execution.

The successful candidate must have 10+ years of piping experience, including at least 5 years in a construction leadership role, and possess a strong working knowledge of industrial piping installation, fabrication, welding, testing, mechanical equipment interfaces, and field construction practices.

This is a hands-on field leadership position for an individual who can effectively manage multiple crews and work fronts while maintaining Greenberry Industrial's expectations for safety, quality, productivity, schedule, and craftsmanship.

Key Responsibilities

Piping Field Leadership

  • Provide direct field leadership for multiple piping crews, Foremen, Pipefitters, Welders, and other assigned craft personnel.
  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee daily piping construction activities in alignment with project schedules and priorities.
  • Assign manpower and resources across multiple work areas and adjust crew allocation based on project needs and changing priorities.
  • Work closely with the Piping Superintendent to develop daily and weekly work plans and manpower requirements.
  • Ensure Foremen understand assigned scopes, drawings, specifications, production expectations, and project requirements.
  • Monitor crew performance and provide coaching, direction, and corrective action as necessary.
  • Maintain strong field presence and actively engage with crews to identify and remove barriers to productivity.
  • Coordinate piping construction with equipment installation and other mechanical construction activities.

Piping Installation & Technical Execution

  • Oversee installation of industrial process piping, utility piping, valves, supports, hangers, equipment connections, and associated piping systems.
  • Ensure piping is installed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, P&IDs, isometrics, applicable codes, and project quality requirements.
  • Review piping isometrics, orthographic drawings, P&IDs, spool drawings, specifications, and associated construction documents.
  • Verify proper piping layout, elevations, dimensions, routing, orientation, supports, and equipment connections.
  • Coordinate field fit-up, fabrication, installation, and welding activities.
  • Identify drawing discrepancies, constructability concerns, interferences, and field conflicts and escalate them for resolution.
  • Coordinate piping tie-ins and other critical work activities with project leadership.
  • Support pressure testing, flushing, cleaning, inspection, system completion, commissioning, and turnover activities.
  • Ensure installed systems are complete, accessible, properly supported, and ready for inspection and testing.

Planning, Productivity & Manpower

  • Develop and execute short-interval work plans in coordination with Superintendent and Project Management teams.
  • Plan work ahead to ensure labor, materials, tools, equipment, drawings, permits, and work areas are available before crews begin assigned activities.
  • Monitor installed quantities, labor hours, production rates, and crew performance.
  • Identify productivity issues and implement corrective measures before they negatively impact the project schedule.
  • Coordinate manpower needs, crew composition, and craft assignments with project leadership.
  • Support schedule development and communicate progress, constraints, and forecasted completion dates.
  • Participate in look-ahead planning and coordination meetings.
  • Maintain focus on efficient execution while protecting safety, quality, and workmanship.

Material, Equipment & Workface Coordination

  • Verify required piping materials, fittings, valves, supports, consumables, tools, and equipment are available before work begins.
  • Coordinate material staging and distribution to minimize unnecessary craft movement and downtime.
  • Identify shortages, damaged materials, incorrect material, or procurement concerns and communicate issues promptly.
  • Coordinate crane picks, lifts, equipment setting, scaffolding, access, and other supporting activities required for piping installation.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and efficient work areas.
  • Coordinate with other trades to minimize congestion and prevent workface conflicts.

Quality & Welding Coordination

  • Work closely with Greenberry Quality personnel to ensure piping and welding activities meet project specifications and applicable quality requirements.
  • Ensure crews follow approved welding procedures, installation requirements, inspection practices, and required documentation.
  • Coordinate fit-up, weld inspections, testing, punch-list activities, and system turnover.
  • Ensure proper material identification and control are maintained throughout installation.
  • Address quality concerns, nonconformances, and rework promptly.
  • Promote a culture of doing the work correctly the first time and minimizing rework.
  • Support required documentation associated with piping installation, weld quality, testing, inspection, and turnover.

Safety Leadership

  • Demonstrate visible field leadership and personal accountability for safe work execution.
  • Enforce Greenberry Industrial safety policies, OSHA requirements, client requirements, and site-specific safety procedures.
  • Lead and support pre-task planning, job hazard analyses, toolbox talks, and daily safety discussions.
  • Verify crews understand work hazards and appropriate controls before beginning work.
  • Monitor field conditions and stop work when unsafe conditions or behaviors are identified.
  • Coordinate with Safety personnel and field leadership to proactively identify and mitigate hazards.
  • Reinforce expectations regarding PPE, fall protection, lifting and rigging, hot work, confined spaces, elevated work, line-of-fire hazards, and other applicable construction activities.
  • Promote a culture where employees are expected and empowered to raise safety concerns.

Semiconductor Facility Coordination

  • Lead piping construction activities within a highly controlled semiconductor facility environment.
  • Ensure crews comply with client requirements for access, safety, security, cleanliness, work-area controls, permits, and documentation.
  • Coordinate activities around active operations, sensitive equipment, restricted areas, and other contractors.
  • Work closely with electrical, controls, structural, equipment-installation, and other mechanical teams to sequence work and resolve conflicts.
  • Maintain high standards of housekeeping, material control, and work-area organization.
  • Support shutdowns, tie-ins, critical installation windows, and other schedule-sensitive activities as required.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 10+ years of piping construction experience within industrial, manufacturing, semiconductor, high-tech, energy, or similarly complex construction environments.
  • 5+ years of construction leadership experience as a Foreman, General Foreman, Superintendent, or comparable piping leadership position.
  • Extensive hands-on knowledge of industrial/process piping installation and fabrication.
  • Strong understanding of pipefitting, welding, piping supports, valves, mechanical equipment connections, and piping system installation.
  • Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, piping isometrics, orthographic drawings, specifications, spool drawings, and other construction documents.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multiple crews and Foremen simultaneously.
  • Experience planning manpower, materials, tools, equipment, and daily production requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of construction safety requirements and field safety leadership.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with craft employees, Foremen, Superintendents, Project Managers, Quality, Safety, and client representatives.
  • Strong leadership, organization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Phoenix, Arizona.

Preferred

  • Previous experience working on semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, cleanroom, advanced manufacturing, pharmaceutical, or mission-critical projects.
  • Direct experience with process piping, high-purity piping, mechanical equipment installation, process utilities, and specialty piping systems.
  • Experience leading large piping crews across multiple active work fronts.
  • Familiarity with piping weld procedures, weld mapping, material traceability, NDE/NDT, pressure testing, inspection, and turnover requirements.
  • Experience working under demanding project schedules in highly controlled operating environments.
  • Experience coordinating piping installations with equipment, structural, electrical, controls, and other interfacing trades.

Physical Requirements

This is an active field construction leadership position. The employee must be able to:

  • Perform physical work associated with industrial construction and piping installation.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday, including on uneven construction surfaces.
  • Climb stairs, ladders, and access elevated work areas as required.
  • Bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach, and work in varying positions associated with piping construction.
  • Safely lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Work indoors and outdoors and in varying temperature and environmental conditions.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment for the duration of work in designated construction areas.
  • Safely work around active construction operations, heavy equipment, piping systems, welding activities, and other industrial hazards.

Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $76.00 per hour.
  • Applicable fringe benefits provided in accordance with prevailing-wage requirements.
  • Full-time employment with Greenberry Industrial.
  • Opportunity to provide senior field leadership on a large, high-profile semiconductor construction project.
  • Opportunity for continued advancement into Piping Superintendent and broader construction leadership roles.

Actual wages and applicable fringe benefits will be administered in accordance with the applicable prevailing-wage determination, employee classification, project requirements, and applicable law.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Greenberry Industrial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Delivery Associate, Proactive Care
description:
🌍 A Bit About Us

At Doccla we’re redefining where and how healthcare is delivered.

We made our name as the UK’s leading provider of Virtual Wards, designed to help hospitals discharge patients sooner and to care for them safely at home. Now Doccla is investing in technology-enabled proactive care to prevent people from unnecessary hospitalisation at a scale that can have a meaningful impact.

We provide everything clinicians need to deliver safe, effective Virtual Care across the full acuity spectrum, under one managed service. That spans Virtual Wards, helping hospitals discharge patients sooner and care for them safely at home, and Proactive Care, preventing unnecessary hospitalisation for the highest-risk patients in the community. Behind both sits a CQC-regulated clinical team, medical-grade devices, logistics, patient onboarding, EHR integration, and an AI-powered care platform built around real-world workflows.

We currently work with over 60% of NHS ICBs and support health systems across the UK, Ireland and the DACH region to reduce hospital pressure, improve outcomes, and create a more resilient model of care.

We're backed by top European investors, having secured £35m in Series B funding led by Lakestar, with participation from Elaia, General Catalyst, Speedinvest, and Bertelsmann.

🚀 Why Join Us?

This is your chance to join Doccla at a key stage in our growth.

We’re building the category leader in Virtual Care and Remote Patient Monitoring. You’ll be part of a highly entrepreneurial, mission-driven team that combines expertise across clinical, technical, commercial, and operational domains.

We’re solving real problems for patients and health systems and growing fast.

🧑‍⚕️ What You’ll Do as a Deliver Associate

This role suits someone with at least two years’ professional experience, ideally in consulting. You will help set up and run large NHS proactive care programmes from contract signature to go-live, keeping governance, plans and actions on track so we deliver at pace.

Set up and run programme governance

  • Stand up governance for new programmes: terms of reference, steering and operational groups, and meeting cadence

  • Prepare agendas, papers and minutes, and set up workstreams with clear owners and next steps

Plan, track and keep delivery moving

  • Build and maintain programme plans, RAID logs and action trackers

  • Chase owners inside Doccla and at client organisations, and flag slippage early with options

Create high-quality materials

  • Build steering group packs, client presentations and highlight reports, often to tight deadlines

  • Turn meeting notes and spreadsheets into clear documents a senior NHS audience can act on

Support reporting and coordination

  • Track enrolment and progress against plan, working with our Data team

  • Coordinate between Doccla teams (Clinical, Product, Data, Patient Support, Logistics) and client programme teams

💡 What We’re Looking For

You'll be a strong fit if you have:

  • At least two years’ professional experience in consulting, programme or project delivery, PMO or a client-facing role

  • A track record of running governance, plans and RAID logs, and producing materials for senior stakeholders

  • Excellent organisation. You can juggle several workstreams and deadlines without dropping anything

  • Clear written communication. You can turn a messy discussion into a crisp summary or slide

  • Confidence with PowerPoint, Excel and project tools (for example Jira or Asana)

  • Good analytical skills and strong attention to detail

  • Strong interpersonal skills to build relationships with clients and colleagues

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • A couple of years in consulting, ideally in health or the public sector

  • Exposure to the NHS, public sector or health tech

  • Familiarity with project management methods such as PRINCE2, APM or Agile

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Are reliable. You follow through without being chased

  • Are curious, solve problems and raise risks early with senior stakeholders

  • Use AI and new tools to make yourself and the team faster

  • Strong work ethic and comfortable working at pace in a growing start-up environment

  • Care about keeping people at high risk of admission well and at home

🧠 How We Work

We empower everyone at Doccla to take ownership of their work and the company's mission. We act ethically and always put patient safety and outcomes first.

To thrive here, you’ll need a can-do attitude and an action-oriented approach, along with a willingness to learn and grow through open feedback.

We’re a hybrid team, with offices in London, Denmark, Germany. Most of our team is London-based and enjoys in-person time at our WeWork HQ 1–3 days per week, where you’ll find great lunch, barista coffee, and a pet-friendly space. Some of our teams are fully remote, depending on the team and responsibilities. This includes our Engineering, Clinical & Patient Support teams.

🎁 What You’ll Get

Annual Leave & Holidays
🌴 25 days annual leave + up to 8 UK bank holidays [this varies depending on the role]
🔄 Option to buy or sell holidays

Remote Working
🏡 Flexible remote options
💻 Remote working stipend

Financial Benefits
📈 Employee stock options
💸 4% pension on full basic pay
🛡️ 4x salary life insurance

Health & Wellness
🩺 Private health insurance
🫄 4 months full pay for birthing parent*
👶🏽 4 weeks full pay for non-birthing parent*
👶🏽 Phased return back to paid work
🤒 Sick pay

In-Office Perks (London HQ)
🍝 Free daily lunch
🐶 Pet-friendly office

Other Benefits
📚 £500 L&D budget per person
🚲 Cycle to work scheme

Via Smart Health:
🧑‍⚕️ 24/7 GP appointments
🧠 Mental health support
🥗 Nutrition & fitness advice
🧪 Second opinions & health checks

🏆 In Return for Your Hard Work

  • A competitive compensation package (base + stock options), with half-year and annual performance reviews

  • The chance to work on patient-first, system-level healthcare challenges in one of Europe’s leading healthtech companies

  • Opportunities for growth and leadership we want you to challenge the status quo, own your impact, and continue developing, with our full support

🤝 Diversity at Doccla

We embrace diversity. To build a great product, we need a team with a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

We’re committed to equal opportunity hiring regardless of race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or background. If you're excited about the role, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every point.

🔐 Safer Recruitment

We are committed to safer recruitment practices. As Doccla is a CQC registered company, a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check will be required for all roles.

It is an offence to apply for such work if you are barred from working with children or vulnerable adults.

title: Payment Processing Representative (USA)
description:
Remote Payment Processing Representative Needed for a Manufacturing Company


Role Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, trustworthy Payment Processing & Banking Representative to manage their daily electronic transactions and in-person banking operations. You will be responsible for reconciling digital payments, processing invoices, handling physical bank deposits, and ensuring all financial records remain accurate and secure.


Key Responsibilities

Electronic Payment Processing

  • Digital transactions. Process, verify, and track incoming and outgoing electronic payments across company platforms (ACH, wire transfers, credit/debit cards, cryptocurrency, and merchant portals).
  • Billing and invoicing. Generate customer invoices, send payment links, and follow up on pending or failed transactions.
  • Payment troubleshooting. Resolve declined payments, chargebacks, and billing discrepancies promptly with customers and payment processors.

Banking & Cash Handling

  • Make cash and check deposits, obtain cashier's checks, and handle in-person account requests.
  • Cash and check management. Count, log, and prepare physical cash and checks for deposit in accordance with company security policies.
  • Branch liaison. Communicate with bank tellers and relationship managers to verify transaction receipts and resolve deposit issues.

Reconciliation & Record Keeping

  • Daily reconciliation. Match electronic payment settlements and physical bank deposit slips against internal accounting records and sales logs.
  • Documentation. Maintain organized digital and physical records of all receipts, wire confirmations, and bank statements for auditing purposes.
  • Compliance and security. Follow strict internal controls and data privacy standards when handling sensitive customer payment details and company funds.
