title: Senior .NET Engineer — Remote, Data-Driven Backend
description:
Cylynt is hiring a hands-on software engineer to own features end to end in a remote, Dublin-influenced team. You’ll work on SmartFlow, an ASP.NET Web Forms-based web app with SQL Server, focusing on performance, security, and scalable design.

Expect coding in C#, T-SQL, JavaScript, and occasional AWS-driven deployments. You’ll join a small, focused team with flexible time, regular code reviews, and opportunities to shape architecture while avoiding people-management duties.

Own features end to end from schema to UI. Optimize queries and design schemas for growing data. Review peers and engage in technical discussions. Collaborate with engineers building client-side agent and data pipelines. Maintain security controls and OWASP principles. Around 5 years of professional C#/.NET web development, including Web Forms. Solid SQL Server skills: T-SQL, indexing, execution plans. Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Experience deploying ASP.NET apps on IIS. Understanding of web app security and data handling. Comfort with source control, CI/CD and code review. Competitive salary Pension and health insurance 24 annual leave days Company Laptop Technical career path

title: Hybrid Mainframe PL/I Analyst–Developer
description:
KEYES is seeking an Analyst Developer PL/I – Mainframe to reinforce a Mainframe development team within a large Belgian organisation. You will combine technical analysis, hands‑on development, maintenance, testing and application support on legacy PL/I applications in a IBM Mainframe environment.

You will contribute to stability, evolution and long‑term maintainability, working with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders to ensure production readiness and quality.

Perform technical analysis of existing Mainframe applications and business requirements. Develop, modify and maintain applications written in PL/I. Work on corrective and evolutionary maintenance of business‑critical applications. Analyse existing code, application flows and technical dependencies before implementing changes. Develop and maintain batch processing and, where applicable, transactional processing. Work with DB2 databases and embedded SQL within Mainframe applications. Create, modify and maintain JCL jobs and batch chains. Work with IMS / DL/I and CICS environments where applicable. Perform unit, integration and non‑regression testing. Investigate application issues, production incidents and defects. Perform troubleshooting and root cause analysis on Mainframe applications. Analyse ABENDs, batch failures, SQL errors and application behaviour. Support deployment and production activities. Contribute to performance optimisation of Mainframe programs and database access. Collaborate with analysts, developers, production teams and stakeholders. Document technical analyses, developments and fixes. Contribute to long‑term stability and maintainability of legacy systems. Extensive PL/I experience in a professional Mainframe environment. Strong knowledge of IBM Mainframe and z/OS. Experience with DB2 and SQL. Good understanding of JCL and batch processing. Experience with testing and production support. Company car Mobility budget Meal vouchers

title: Data Management Analyst — Parental Leave Cover to 2028
description:
TCorp's Data & Analytics team is looking for an Analyst, Data Management to help ensure investment data is accurate, reliable and accessible across key platforms including Matrix, TCorp’s Enterprise Datastore and Aladdin. You'll work across data quality, SQL, data pipelines and process improvement, while partnering with stakeholders to deliver robust and repeatable data solutions.

The role is a parental leave cover maximum term employment opportunity to January 2028.

Maintain and validate investment, fund and security data Monitor data processes and pipelines, including Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Factory Develop and test data quality rules and SQL functions Support onboarding and integration of new datasets Identify opportunities for automation and smarter processes Work with stakeholders to improve data quality and deliver reliable solutions Qualifications in mathematics, a quantitative discipline or relevant practical experience. Strong SQL and Microsoft Excel capability. An understanding of scalable data validation. Strong problem solving and communication skills. The ability to work independently while contributing as part of a collaborative team. Financial services experience is advantageous, but not essential.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Commonwealth Bank of Australia seeks an experienced SRE leader to guide a medium-sized team of engineers in Sydney. You will drive reliability, performance and scalable software delivery across our award-winning banking apps, applying SRE principles to observability and incident response.

You’ll mentor engineers, improve SLIs/SLOs, promote a positive engineering culture, and solve complex technical challenges at scale, contributing to Australia’s largest digital transformation.

Manage a medium-sized team of Engineers with goal setting, performance, development and engagement. Advocate embedding a positive engineering culture, ensuring standards and technical quality. Guide complex technical problem solving across services and systems. Experience in SRE philosophy, principles and practices - creating/reviewing SLI, SLO and SLA's. Proven leadership to engineers and talent development. Experience designing, developing, testing and supporting applications and systems. Solid background in system and application performance testing, programming and monitoring performance and network communication.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Mytra is seeking a Senior Data Software Engineer to build the data platform used by all software and robotics systems. You will design data capture lanes, storage tiers, and pipelines across edge and cloud environments, ensuring durability, policy-driven retention, and scalable ingestion.

You will own the transformation engine, establish ID keying and crosswalks, and shape schemas and data contracts while aligning with cost and egress constraints.

Design the data capture lanes, storage tiers, and pipeline layout. Redesign the ingestion service to scale. Build the transform machinery and data engine you own; developers write the transforms. Create durable paths for what the system does and must remember. Build the ID keying and crosswalk tables that connect facts to site, robot, and more. Own retention, cost and egress policies; manage per-record retention and site-to-cloud replication. Run services in cloud and on customer sites with CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. 5+ years building and running production backend or data infrastructure. Experience with columnar stores, relational databases, and No-SQL databases in production and understanding tradeoffs. Strong communication and ability to convey complex ideas to a diverse audience. Experience with Go, Python, Rust, Java or C++ in production. Experience with data services ingestion/CDC/event pipelines. Experience with ClickHouse, Parquet, Iceberg. Shipped services with CI/CD, monitoring, alerting. BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent from having done the work. Ownership, accountability, and taking on responsibility.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer - Data-Driven, Hybrid in Dublin
description:
Brightwater is partnering with a well-established Irish organisation to recruit a hands-on UX/UI Designer for its Dublin-based digital team. You will own key customer journeys, using GA4 and user research to identify drop-offs, and design and publish improvements in the CMS.

The role requires leading workshops, collaborating with developers and stakeholders, and ensuring accessibility and consistency across pages.

Own key customer journeys on the website from insight to launch. Use GA4 data and user research to identify drop-offs and opportunities. Design and prototype improvements in Figma and publish in the CMS. Lead workshops with technical and business stakeholders and gain buy-in. Collaborate with developers, product owners and business units. 4–5+ years as a UX Designer, UI Designer or similar, ideally in-house. Experience using GA4 to measure engagement and drop-off. Hands-on CMS experience (Sitecore, AEM, Optimizely, Drupal or similar). Strong Figma skills for prototyping and testing ideas. Ability to run workshops and influence stakeholders across levels. Experience with usability testing and A/B testing. Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards and design systems. Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and frontend implications. Hybrid working in Dublin Competitive benefits package

title: Senior .NET Architect
description:
TALEO Consulting Group in Brussels is seeking a senior .NET Architect to technically lead a portfolio of complex applications, including Blazor front-ends and microservices. You will drive architecture decisions and collaborate with product owners.

The role emphasizes coaching experienced developers, guiding agile SCRUM teams, and coordinating cross-domain delivery. Expect hybrid work with two days on site and three remote, and a strong focus on modernizing to .NET 10 and Kubernetes.

Lead a portfolio of complex applications across domains (Blazor front-end). Support architecture design and challenge technical choices with leads and product owners. Migrate and modernise services to .NET 10 with Kubernetes within 2 years. Coach and coordinate multiple full-stack .NET teams in Scrum. Define target architecture vision and run collaborative sessions with developers and architects. 4+ years of experience as a .NET Architect. Experience with Blazor front-end and microservices. Strong architectural and analytical skills. Excellent communication and coaching abilities. Experience in Scrum teams and agile delivery.

title: Day/Night Pressure Washer Tech
description:
Kept Companies is the largest self-performing commercial cleaning and maintenance company in the nation. With nine leading brands and over 100 locations nationwide servicing industries including restaurant, solar, retail, transportation, and supermarket. Kept Companies is the leading provider of commercial fleet washing, retail equipment refurbishing and sales, refrigeration, hood, coil and solar panel cleaning, and parking lot services.


Responsibilities

  • Perform pressure washing services for residential and commercial properties
  • Operate and maintain pressure washing equipment
  • Clean and prepare surfaces prior to pressure washing
  • Remove dirt, grime, mold, and other contaminants from various surfaces
  • Ensure safety protocols are followed during all operations
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area


Requirements

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Valid Driver’s License with a clean driving record
  • Must be 21 years of age or older
  • Experience with pressure washing equipment and techniques (preferred)
  • Ability to troubleshoot and perform basic maintenance on equipment
  • Physical ability to lift 50–70 lbs and work in various weather conditions
  • Good communication and time management skills
  • Must pass a background check and DMV record check


Benefits

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • 401K
  • PTO

title: SRE: Scale, Automation & High-Availability Systems
description:
TikTok is seeking graduates for its site Reliability Engineering team in Australia. You will contribute to reliability, automation, and scalable infrastructure across storage, computing, and databases, guided by strong mentorship and hands-on project ownership.

Ideal candidates have degrees in software fields and experience with Python/Go/Java, plus familiarity with Linux and modern deployment tools. Roles begin in 2027, with rolling application reviews.

Reliability Oversight: Ensure performance and efficiency of core infrastructure; establish reliability standards and recovery SOPs. Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate issues, perform bottleneck analyses, and improve high-availability architecture. Efficiency Mastery: Develop automated operation solutions for large-scale systems with system development teams. Cost Optimization: Manage budgets and monitoring to optimize company costs. Bachelor's or Master’s degree in software-related field. Solid knowledge of Linux, storage, and networking fundamentals. Proficiency in Python, Go, and/or Java; familiarity with design patterns.

title: Laravel PHP Developer - APIs, SQL & Payments
description:
ACELABS Solutions Private Limited in Madurai invites a developer with hands-on experience in PHP and Laravel, SQL schema design, REST API design, and front-end skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Strong coding standards and experience with Bootstrap, jQuery/Ajax are a plus.

You should have 1 to 2 years of experience and be comfortable interacting with clients and internal teams to gather requirements and build scalable solutions. Excellent problem-solving and database design skills are essential.

Interact with clients and internal teams to gather requirements and develop solutions. Provide suggestions and schedules while addressing technical and process issues. Any degree required. 1 to 2 years of experience. Hands-on experience with SQL schema design and REST API design. Strong knowledge of PHP and Laravel.

title: Software Engineer - C#/.NET & AI-Native Apps
description:
Harry Walsh Associates Ltd. in Cork, Ireland, is seeking a software professional to join its new European office. You will develop secure, scalable enterprise applications using C#, .NET Core/Framework, Web APIs, and modern front-end frameworks.

You will work with local and international teams on AI-native projects such as Verca, contributing from prototype to production while applying secure development practices.

Develop secure, scalable enterprise applications using C#, .NET Core/Framework. Build and maintain Web APIs and integrations with Azure and external services. Contribute to AI-native projects and production-ready prototypes. Collaborate with local and international colleagues across projects. Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. At least 3 years of professional software development experience. Experience with C#, .NET, Web APIs, and front-end JS frameworks.

title: Backend Engineer (based in Dublin OR Madrid)
description:
Fresco seeks a Backend Engineer to work on the Fresco KitchenOS platform, delivering reliable backend services for IoT devices and mobile clients. You will join a team reporting to the Platform & Firmware Engineering Manager, building scalable capabilities and supporting production operations.

Ideal candidates have 3+ years of Python backend experience, strong event-driven architecture skills, and hands-on AWS Lambda + CDK experience.

Develop reliable and scalable backend services on Python for our IoT devices and mobile clients across ~20 Lambda-based microservices (Python 3.14, AWS CDK, aws-lambda-powertools). Be involved and participate in the overall application lifecycle. Execute cloud to cloud integrations with new partners. Be on shift looking after the platform, frequency: 1 week every 4-5 weeks (Remunerated). Stay up-to-date with innovations and changes in the industry. 3+ years building backend services in Python. Strong grasp of event-driven architecture: EventBridge, SQS/SNS, async patterns. AWS Lambda + CDK in production — not just familiarity. Observability: structured logging, distributed tracing (Datadog or equivalent). Fluent in English; clear communicator with both technical peers and less-technical stakeholders. Equity

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
SD Solutions is partnering with MortgageTech Client #1 to identify a Senior Full Stack Developer. You will work across the stack, delivering features with Vue 3 and TypeScript on the frontend and Django with DRF on the backend, while evolving loan pricing and investor eligibility engines.

You will design scalable data models, integrate with loan origination and due diligence providers, and ensure robust test coverage using pytest, Vitest, and Playwright.

Build features across the stack: Vue 3 + TypeScript on the frontend and Django + DRF on the backend. Evolve core engines: loan pricing and investor eligibility matching. Integrate with mortgage ecosystem: LOS platforms, due diligence providers, credit and valuation vendors. Design data models and pipelines that scale with volume. Write tests with pytest, Vitest, and Playwright to ensure quality. 5+ years building production software on both frontend and backend stacks. 3+ years hands-on Vue.js + TypeScript. Strong Python + Django, REST API design, and database skills.

title: Remote Senior ML Scientist - Real-Time, Scalable Models
description:
Intuition Machines, Inc. is seeking an ML Applied Scientist to design, implement, and scale machine learning systems powering our security products. You’ll translate business goals into technical specifications and mentor other ML researchers in a fast-paced production environment.

This fully remote role enables global collaboration with teams around the world, with opportunities to ship real-time models under memory and compute constraints, contributing to high-impact products used by millions.

Build ML models that can scale to millions of requests per second while maintaining performance. Translate business requirements into technical specifications. Develop ML models that satisfy memory and compute constraints, evaluate them properly, and debug effectively. Provide technical mentorship to other ML research engineers. Iterate quickly, with a focus on shipping early and often, ensuring that new products or features can be deployed to millions of users. Write clearly structured, maintainable, well-documented, and tested code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Participate in code reviews and architecture & design sessions. Stay updated on recent technological developments and assess their applicability. Provide technical input to the research roadmap. 5+ years of professional experience in applied ML. Experience with the entire modeling lifecycle: building, evaluating, and debugging large ML models. Experience with large-scale categorical and structured data. Expertise in real-time ML models, incremental learning, and online learning. Strong understanding of ML fundamentals: bias-variance tradeoffs, loss functions, evaluation metrics. Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Thoughtful, self-directed individual who can make technical decisions independently. Fully remote Flexible hours Global team Cutting-edge ML R&D

title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Database Observability (Remote)
description:
Grafana Labs is seeking a frontend engineer to build experiences for Grafana Cloud, focusing on React and TypeScript. You will collaborate with backend engineers and product teams to move ideas from exploration to production, delivering polished user experiences for database observability.

You will own projects end-to-end, mentor teammates, participate in on-call rotations, and contribute to open-source communities while working in a fully remote global team.

Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout with user feedback. Collaborate with Product Management, Design and backend engineers to build intuitive experiences. Mentor and collaborate with other engineers to raise the engineering bar. Participate in on-call for the software you help build and respond to incidents. Provide technical support in customer escalations and address areas of high friction. Contribute to design proposals and share work through demos and technical discussions. Strong frontend engineering experience with React and TypeScript. Experience building production web applications. Experience with backend services and APIs is a plus. Experience with on-call production support. Open-source contribution or maintainership is a plus. Experience with databases or performance monitoring. 30 days paid vacation Health coverage or stipends Pension contributions Learning & development stipend $1,500 Remote-friendly with home-office setup Co-working space stipend up to $175/mo Headspace mindfulness subscription Employee Assistance Program Paid parental leave

title: Senior AI Engineer – Production Systems
description:
ABB Inc is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, build and deploy scalable ML/LLM solutions in a hybrid setup. You will work with data scientists, engineers and stakeholders across the solution lifecycle to bring AI capabilities into reliable production services.

You will advance MLOps/LLMOps practices, ensure monitoring, data and prompt governance, and mentor junior team members in engineering best practices within a hybrid work model.

Design, develop and deploy scalable ML and LLM solutions. Automate deployment using CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and feature management. Establish MLOps/LLMOps processes, monitoring, and governance. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product owners, and stakeholders. Degree or practical experience in computer science, AI, or data science. 5+ years delivering production ML/AI solutions and supporting lifecycle. Experience with MLOps/LLMOps tooling including CI/CD, versioning, evaluation, monitoring.
